name: PageFormat
doc: A page size in points (1/72").

methods.name: custom
methods.doc: A custom page size; both dimensions must be positive and finite.

methods.name: landscape
methods.doc: This format oriented so width >= height (returns `this` if already so).

methods.name: portrait
methods.doc: This format oriented so height >= width (returns `this` if already so).

methods.name: mediaBox
methods.doc: The `/MediaBox` rectangle `[0, 0, width, height]` for this format.

name: GoToAction
doc: A GoTo action: jump to a page in this document.

name: UriAction
doc: A URI action: open an external URL.

name: SubmitAction
doc: A SubmitForm action: send the form's field values to `url`.

properties.name: exclude
properties.doc: Treat `fields` as an exclusion list (/Flags IncludeExclude).

name: ResetAction
doc: A ResetForm action: clear the named fields, or every field.

name: JavaScriptAction
doc: A JavaScript action.

name: PdfAction
doc: Any action this library models, for an annotation's /A.

name: FieldActions
doc: A field's additional-actions (/AA), PDF 32000-1 table 197.

properties.name: keystroke
properties.doc: /K — fires on each keystroke while the value is being edited.

properties.name: validate
properties.doc: /V — validates the value when it changes.

properties.name: calculate
properties.doc: /C — recalculates the value when another field changes.

name: FieldActionsUpdate
doc: A field-actions update: an action to set, `null` to remove that trigger, and  an absent key to leave it as it is — the same shape `SetStyle` takes.

name: pdfText
doc: A PdfString tagged object carrying a PDF text string.

name: encodeAction
doc: Build the /A dict for `a`.

name: urlOf
doc: The URL from a SubmitForm /F: a /FS /URL filespec, or a bare string, which  some producers write.

name: parseAction
doc: Parse `annot`'s /A action, or undefined when absent or unmodelled.

name: parseStandaloneAction
doc: Parse an action dict that is not an annotation's /A — a field's /AA /F, say.

name: parseActionDict
doc: The body shared by both: `host` is where a GoTo destination may live besides  the action's own /D.

name: parseFieldActions
doc: Read a field's /AA into the typed view.

name: encodeFieldActions
doc: Build the /AA dict for a plain set of triggers, or undefined when none were  given.

name: applyFieldActions
doc: Apply an update to a field's /AA.

properties.name: entry
properties.doc: The raw /N (or /AS-selected) entry, un-promoted: a ref, or an inline stream.

name: numArray
doc: Resolve `o` to a fixed-length array of finite numbers, or undefined.

name: annotFlags
doc: The annotation's /F flag bitfield (0 when absent).

name: isAnnotVisible
doc: True when a static page render should draw this annotation: not Hidden, not NoView, and not a /Popup — a popup is the note window belonging to a parent markup annotation, which viewers draw only while the note is open.

name: normalEntry
doc: The raw /AP /N entry to draw.

name: resolveAppearance
doc: The appearance to draw for `annot` and where to place it, or undefined when there is none usable: no /AP, an /N state subdict with no matching /AS, a missing /Rect or /BBox, or a degenerate placement.

name: Annotation
doc: A live, mutable handle over an annotation dictionary.

methods.name: Flatten
methods.doc: Bake just this annotation into static page content: draw its /AP /N  appearance into the page's /Contents at its /Rect and drop it from  /Annots.

name: TextAnnotation
doc: A /Text (sticky-note) annotation: an icon-and-popup markup with no appearance  stream.

methods.name: Flatten
methods.doc: Bake just this annotation into static page content: draw its /AP /N  appearance into the page's /Contents at its /Rect and drop it from  /Annots.

name: StampAnnotation
doc: A /Stamp (rubber-stamp) annotation.

methods.name: Flatten
methods.doc: Bake just this annotation into static page content: draw its /AP /N  appearance into the page's /Contents at its /Rect and drop it from  /Annots.

name: MarkupType
doc: The four text-markup subtypes, lower-cased.

name: MarkupAnnotation
doc: A text-markup annotation (/Highlight, /Underline, /StrikeOut, /Squiggly)  positioned by /QuadPoints (8 numbers per marked quad).

methods.name: Flatten
methods.doc: Bake just this annotation into static page content: draw its /AP /N  appearance into the page's /Contents at its /Rect and drop it from  /Annots.

name: ShapeType
doc: 'square' or 'circle' — the two subtypes SquareCircleAnnotation covers.

name: SquareCircleAnnotation
doc: A /Square or /Circle annotation: a stroked (optionally filled) rectangle or  inscribed ellipse in /Rect.

methods.name: Flatten
methods.doc: Bake just this annotation into static page content: draw its /AP /N  appearance into the page's /Contents at its /Rect and drop it from  /Annots.

name: LineEnding
doc: Supported /LE line-ending styles.

name: LineAnnotation
doc: A /Line annotation: a straight segment between /L endpoints with optional  /LE endings (arrowheads/shapes) at each end.

methods.name: Flatten
methods.doc: Bake just this annotation into static page content: draw its /AP /N  appearance into the page's /Contents at its /Rect and drop it from  /Annots.

name: PolyType
doc: 'polygon' or 'polyline' — the two subtypes PolyAnnotation covers.

name: PolyAnnotation
doc: A /Polygon (closed) or /PolyLine (open) annotation: a multi-vertex path in  /Vertices, optionally filled (/IC) and, for polylines, capped with /LE  endings.

methods.name: Flatten
methods.doc: Bake just this annotation into static page content: draw its /AP /N  appearance into the page's /Contents at its /Rect and drop it from  /Annots.

name: InkAnnotation
doc: An /Ink annotation: one or more freehand strokes, each a flat point list in  /InkList.

methods.name: Flatten
methods.doc: Bake just this annotation into static page content: draw its /AP /N  appearance into the page's /Contents at its /Rect and drop it from  /Annots.

name: FreeTextAnnotation
doc: A /FreeText annotation: text drawn directly on the page, optionally with a  callout leader line (/CL, /IT FreeTextCallout, /LE ending).

methods.name: Flatten
methods.doc: Bake just this annotation into static page content: draw its /AP /N  appearance into the page's /Contents at its /Rect and drop it from  /Annots.

name: CaretAnnotation
doc: A /Caret annotation (PDF 32000-1 §12.5.6.11): a text-insertion mark, drawn as  a wedge at the point where text should be added, optionally with a paragraph  sign.

methods.name: Flatten
methods.doc: Bake just this annotation into static page content: draw its /AP /N  appearance into the page's /Contents at its /Rect and drop it from  /Annots.

name: RedactAnnotation
doc: A /Redact annotation (PDF 32000-1 §12.5.6.23): a *mark* over a region, plus  the overlay to paint when it is applied.

methods.name: Flatten
methods.doc: Bake just this annotation into static page content: draw its /AP /N  appearance into the page's /Contents at its /Rect and drop it from  /Annots.

name: PopupAnnotation
doc: A /Popup annotation: a companion window bound to a parent markup via /Parent  (the parent carries /Popup back).

methods.name: Flatten
methods.doc: Bake just this annotation into static page content: draw its /AP /N  appearance into the page's /Contents at its /Rect and drop it from  /Annots.

name: LinkAction
doc: @deprecated Use PdfAction.

name: LinkAnnotation
doc: A /Link annotation.

methods.name: Flatten
methods.doc: Bake just this annotation into static page content: draw its /AP /N  appearance into the page's /Contents at its /Rect and drop it from  /Annots.

doc: A /FileAttachment annotation: an icon on the page whose /FS embeds a file.

methods.doc: Decode the embedded bytes.

name: FreeTextOptions
doc: Options for Page.AddFreeText.

name: LinkOptions
doc: Options for Page.AddLink.

name: checkNums
doc: Validate an array of exactly `n` finite numbers; returns a defensive copy.

name: readTextString
doc: A PDF text string entry, decoded; undefined when absent or not a string.

name: writeTextString
doc: Write (or delete, when `v` is undefined) a PDF text string entry.

name: readQuadPoints
doc: /QuadPoints as a flat list of 8·n finite numbers; [] when absent.

name: writeQuadPoints
doc: Validate and write /QuadPoints: a non-empty list of finite numbers, 8·n.

name: readAlignment
doc: /Q justification as 'left' | 'center' | 'right' (0/1/2).

name: readInteriorColor
doc: /IC interior colour [r,g,b] in 0..1; undefined when absent.

name: readDA
doc: Parsed /DA (font resource name, size, colour); Helv/0/black when absent.
return_type: { fontName: string; size: number; color: [number, number, number] }

name: readBorderWidth
doc: Border width from /BS /W; default 1 when absent or malformed.

name: setBorderWidth
doc: Write /BS << /Type /Border /W v >>.

name: readNumList
doc: All resolved finite numbers in array `o`; [] when `o` is not an array.

name: checkVertices
doc: Validate a flat point list: an even-length list of ≥4 finite numbers (at least  two points).

name: buildDA
doc: Build a /DA PDF string `/<font> <size> Tf r g b rg` (ASCII/latin1).

name: wrapAnnotation
doc: Wrap an annotation dict in its typed handle, dispatching on /Subtype.

name: ownAnnots
doc: The page's own live /Annots array, created and attached when absent.

name: createAnnotation
doc: @internal Build an annotation dict, attach it to the page's own /Annots, and  return the live dict.

name: addTextNote
doc: Build and attach a /Text (sticky-note) annotation to `page`; returns its  TextAnnotation handle.

name: labelSize
doc: Largest font size for `bytes` fitting ~60% of box height and 85% of width.

name: buildLabelAppearance
doc: Build a framed-label /AP form: a stroked border plus centered bold text.

name: buildImageAppearance
doc: Build an /AP form that paints `built` (an Image XObject) to fill the box,  registering it under /Im0 in the form's own /Resources.

name: addStamp
doc: Build and attach a /Stamp annotation to `page`; returns its StampAnnotation  handle.

name: addFileAttachment
doc: Create a /FileAttachment annotation on `page` embedding `opts.bytes`.

name: checkQuads
doc: Validate `quads`: a non-empty list of finite numbers whose length is 8·n.

name: addMarkup
doc: @internal Build a markup annotation of `subtype`, attach it to the page, set  /QuadPoints + optional /CA, and install an /AP /N drawn by `draw`.

name: addHighlight
doc: Build and attach a /Highlight markup annotation to `page`.

name: addUnderline
doc: Build and attach an /Underline markup annotation to `page`.

name: addStrikeOut
doc: Build and attach a /StrikeOut markup annotation to `page`.

name: addSquiggly
doc: Build and attach a /Squiggly markup annotation to `page`.

name: checkOptColor
doc: Validate an optional RGB color; returns a defensive copy or undefined.

name: checkOptWidth
doc: Validate an optional border width; default 1.

name: checkOptOpacity
doc: Validate an optional /CA opacity in 0..1; undefined passes through.

name: checkCallout
doc: Validate a /CL callout: 4 or 6 finite numbers; returns a defensive copy.

name: addSquareCircle
doc: @internal Shared builder for /Square and /Circle.

name: addSquare
doc: Build and attach a /Square annotation to `page`.

name: addCircle
doc: Build and attach a /Circle annotation to `page`.

name: addCaret
doc: Build and attach a /Caret text-insertion annotation to `page`: a filled wedge  marking where text should be inserted, with an optional paragraph sign.

name: addLine
doc: Build and attach a /Line annotation to `page`.

name: addPolygon
doc: Build and attach a closed /Polygon annotation to `page`.

name: addPolyline
doc: Build and attach an open /PolyLine annotation to `page`, with optional end  arrowheads.

name: addInk
doc: Build and attach an /Ink annotation to `page`: one or more freehand strokes  (drawn as straight polylines through the points).

name: addFreeText
doc: Build and attach a /FreeText annotation to `page`: text drawn on the page,  optionally with a /CL callout leader (arrowhead at its first point).

name: rectToQuad
doc: @internal One /QuadPoints quad covering `r`, in the TL, TR, BL, BR order  PDF 32000-1 §12.5.6.10 specifies.

name: addRedact
doc: Build and attach a /Redact annotation to `page`.

name: defaultPopupRect
doc: Default popup rect: a ~200×100 box beside the parent's /Rect (right, top).

name: refForAnnot
doc: Find the /Annots ref that resolves to `dict` on `page`; throws when `dict`  is not an indirect annotation on this page.

name: createPopup
doc: @internal Build a /Popup dict, attach it to the page, link it to its parent  (/Parent → parentRef, parent /Popup → new popup).

name: addPopup
doc: Build and attach a /Popup annotation bound to `opts.parent`.

name: addLink
doc: Build and attach a /Link annotation to `page`; returns its LinkAnnotation  handle.

properties.name: page
properties.doc: 0-based page index — XFDF's own convention for the page attribute.

properties.name: dict
properties.doc: Self-contained annotation dict: refs inlined, STRIPPED keys removed.

properties.name: popupName
properties.doc: /NM of this annotation's popup, when it has one.

properties.name: inReplyTo
properties.doc: /NM of the annotation this one replies to, when it is a reply.

name: inlineRefs
doc: Deep-copy `o`, resolving every reference to the object it points at, so the  result stands alone with no dependency on the document's object map.

name: allocStreams
doc: Deep-copy `o`, replacing every inline stream with a reference to a freshly  allocated object.

name: nameOf
doc: An annotation's /NM as a string; undefined when absent.

name: linkedName
doc: The /NM of the annotation `key` points at, minting one if it has none.

name: collectAnnots
doc: Read every non-widget annotation into the format-neutral model.

name: namedOnPage
doc: Index a page's existing annotations by /NM, for replace-on-import.

name: annotsArray
doc: The page's /Annots array, created and attached when absent.

name: applyAnnots
doc: Graft annotations into the document, reporting what landed and what did not.

name: XFDF_SUBTYPES
doc: The 18 annotation types the XFDF vocabulary covers, as PDF /Subtype names.

name: QuadCorners
doc: A quad's four corners (PDF QuadPoints order: 1=TL, 2=TR, 3=BL, 4=BR).

name: quadsBBox
doc: Axis-aligned bounding box over all corner points of `quads`.
return_type: { minX: number; minY: number; maxX: number; maxY: number }

name: offsetQuads
doc: Split `quads` into per-quad corners, translated into form space (origin at  the quad bbox lower-left, so the form /BBox [0 0 w h] maps onto /Rect).

name: drawHighlight
doc: Fill each quad with the markup color (TL→TR→BR→BL polygon).

name: redactMarkBody
doc: Pending redaction mark: stroke each quad's outline in the mark colour and  fill nothing, so the content underneath stays readable.

name: quadSpan
doc: Per-quad geometry: left/right x span, bottom y, and quad height.
return_type: { xl: number; xr: number; yb: number; h: number }

name: strokeLines
doc: Stroke a horizontal line across each quad at fractional height `frac`  (0 = bottom, 0.5 = middle), with width proportional to quad height.

name: drawUnderline
doc: Underline: a stroke along the bottom edge of each quad.

name: drawStrikeOut
doc: Strike-out: a stroke through the middle of each quad.

name: drawSquiggly
doc: Stroke a zig-zag along the bottom of each quad.

name: freeTextBoxBody
doc: Body for a text box of size w×h at the origin: optional fill, optional inset  border stroke, then wrapped/aligned text (text inset by the border width).

name: installShapeAP
doc: Install `body` as the annotation's /AP /N, wrapping in a /GS0 ExtGState when  opacity < 1 (matching the markup opacity path).

name: paintOp
doc: Painting op for the fill/stroke selection: B = both, S = stroke, f = fill.

name: drawRect
doc: Rectangle inset by half the border so the stroke stays inside the box.

name: drawEllipse
doc: Ellipse inscribed in the inset rect via 4 Bézier quarter-arcs.

name: caretBody
doc: A text-insertion caret: a filled wedge whose two sides curve *inward* to a  sharp apex, on a flat baseline — the proofreader's caret, not a triangle.

name: rot
doc: Rotate vector (vx,vy) by angle `a` radians.

name: drawEnding
doc: Draw an /LE ending at (px,py).

name: paddedRect
doc: Bounding box over a flat point list, padded by `margin`, as an annotation  /Rect [llx, lly, urx, ury].

name: toFormSpace
doc: Translate a flat point list into form space (origin at the /Rect lower-left).

name: unitDir
doc: Unit direction from (ax,ay) toward (bx,by); (0,0)→(1,0) fallback.

name: polyPathBody
doc: Path body: move to the first point, line to the rest, optional close (`h`),  then the fill/stroke paint op.

name: colorOf
doc: RGB from an annotation colour array; undefined when absent or malformed.

name: widthOf
doc: Border width from /BS /W, defaulting to 1 as the Add* path does.

name: numsOf
doc: A flat finite-number list from an array entry; [] when absent or malformed.

name: endingsOf
doc: An /LE pair as ending names, defaulting to None.

name: lineBody
doc: Body for /Line, from /L and /LE.

name: polyBody
doc: Body for /Polygon and /PolyLine, from /Vertices (and /LE for the open form).

name: inkBody
doc: Body for /Ink, from /InkList: one open stroke per subpath.

name: freeTextBody
doc: Body for /FreeText, from /Contents, /DA, /Q and /RD (plus /CL when present).

name: regenerateAppearance
doc: Regenerate the /AP /N appearance for an existing annotation dict, from the  properties the dict already carries.

name: AP_FONT_KEY
doc: The /Resources /Font key every annotation appearance registers its Standard-14  face under.

name: AnnotationMatch
doc: A match in the text one annotation's appearance stream draws.

properties.name: annot
properties.doc: The annotation whose appearance drew the matched text.

properties.name: text
properties.doc: The matched substring of that annotation's assembled appearance text.

properties.name: quads
properties.doc: Page-space boxes [x0,y0,x1,y1], one per line the match spans.

name: AnnotationTextKey
doc: The annotation entries that count as carried text.

name: AnnotationTextMatch
doc: A match in the text an annotation CARRIES, rather than the text it draws.

name: searchAnnotations
doc: Find every occurrence of `find` in the text drawn by the page's annotations.

name: searchAnnotationText
doc: Find every occurrence of `find` in the text the page's annotations CARRY —  a note's body (/Contents), its author (/T), its subject (/Subj) and its rich  content (/RC, reduced to plain text) — none of which is drawn on the page.

name: richTextOf
doc: An annotation's /RC as plain text, or undefined when absent or unparseable.

name: WidgetGeom
doc: Normalized widget geometry: the *layout* box every body composes into, plus  the quarter-turn rotation from /MK /R that maps it onto the widget /Rect.

name: nums
doc: A flat number list from an array; undefined when absent or malformed.

name: widgetGeom
doc: Box geometry from a widget /Rect (normalized, absolute) and /MK /R rotation;  undefined when /Rect is missing or has (near-)zero area.

name: fontResources
doc: A /Resources dict carrying a single Type1 font under `key`, whose /BaseFont is  the resolved Standard-14 `std`.

name: darkenColor
doc: Scale a fill colour toward black by `k` (k < 1 darkens).

name: borderSpec
doc: /BS as the three things a border needs, with the specification's defaults  (width 1, style Solid, dash [3]) for every key the widget omits.
return_type: { w: number; s: string; dash: number[] }

name: bevelOps
doc: The two L-shaped bands of a 3-D border, filled in the ring between inset  `bw` and inset `2*bw` — just inside the /BC stroke.

name: mkOps
doc: Content ops painting the widget's /MK background (/BG) and border (/BC), plus  a border inset for text layout.

name: clipOps
doc: Clip path (`re W n`) limiting painting to the border-inset content rect, so  long values are hard-clipped to the box rather than relying on layout insets.

name: matrixFor
doc: The /Matrix that turns the layout box onto the widget rect.

name: buildAppearanceXObject
doc: Assemble a /Form XObject appearance stream.

name: installAP
doc: Install `stream` as the widget's single normal appearance (/AP /N).

name: installAPState
doc: Install `stream` as the widget's normal appearance for state `state`  (/AP /N /<state>), creating the /AP and /N dicts as needed.

name: autoSize
doc: Largest font size fitting both box height (~0.85·h, capped at 12) and width.

name: centeredBaseline
doc: Baseline y that vertically centers a line of `size` within the box.

name: wrapLines
doc: Greedy word-wrap: split `words` into lines no wider than `maxW` at `size`.

name: wrapTextBody
doc: Body ops for wrapped, aligned text in a box, top-anchored.

name: textOf
doc: Every text run under `node`, concatenated — a heading's own words.

name: maskIfPassword
doc: A password field must never paint its value.

name: zapfResources
doc: A /Resources dict carrying the ZapfDingbats font under /ZaDb (for button marks).

name: glyphBody
doc: Body that draws a ZapfDingbats glyph centered in the box, in `color`.

name: synthOnState
doc: The state name to synthesize for a button's "on" appearance.

name: buildButtonAP
doc: Build and install a button widget's two normal appearances: `onState` and  'Off'.

name: valueStrings
doc: /V as a list of strings: one entry for a single value, one per element for a  multi-select list box's array.

name: selectedIndices
doc: Zero-based /Opt indices to highlight: /I when present, else the entries  matching the value.

name: widgetsOf
doc: The field's widget annotations: a merged field/widget dict is its own widget,  otherwise the resolved /Kids entries.

name: generateFieldAppearance
doc: Generate and install appearance stream(s) for one terminal field across all  its widgets.

name: asciiHexDecode
doc: ASCIIHexDecode: hex digit pairs, whitespace skipped, '>' ends data.

name: ascii85Decode
doc: ASCII85Decode: base-85, whitespace skipped, optional '<~' prefix, 'z' => four  zero bytes, '~>' (or end) ends data.

name: runLengthDecode
doc: RunLengthDecode (PackBits): length 0..127 => copy len+1 literals;  129..255 => repeat next byte 257-len times; 128 => EOD.

name: ascii85Encode
doc: ASCII85Encode: 4 bytes -> 5 base-85 chars in 0x21..0x75; an all-zero 4-byte  group emits 'z'; a partial final group of k bytes (1..3) emits k+1 chars  (pad the group with zero bytes, drop the trailing chars).

name: asciiHexEncode
doc: ASCIIHexEncode: each byte -> two uppercase hex digits, terminated by '>'.

name: runLengthEncode
doc: RunLengthEncode (PackBits): the inverse of runLengthDecode.

name: oidName
doc: Reverse-lookup a dotted OID to its registered name, or undefined.

name: tlv
doc: Wrap `content` in a TLV with the given identifier octet.

name: parse
doc: Parse a single DER TLV starting at `offset`.

name: readInteger
doc: Read a (non-negative) INTEGER node's value as a bigint.

name: readOid
doc: Read an OID node's value as a dotted string.

name: OID
doc: Named OIDs used across the CMS/X.509/PKCS#12/RFC3161 signature stack.

name: der
AutoTagOptions
doc: Options for {@link Document.AutoTag}.

properties.name: force
properties.doc: Re-tag even when the document is already tagged.

properties.name: alt
properties.doc: Alt text for an image; when it returns undefined the image is marked  /Artifact instead of tagged as a Figure.

name: AutoTagReport
doc: Counts of the elements AutoTag produced.

name: centerInside
doc: True when the center of `box` lies inside `region`.

name: tagTables
doc: Tag each table as Table > TR > TH/TD, marking cell content.

name: autoTag
doc: Infer and author a /StructTreeRoot for `doc` from page layout.

name: LinearBarcode
doc: 1D barcode geometry: alternating bar/space run widths in unit modules.

name: MatrixBarcode
doc: 2D barcode geometry: a square matrix of dark/light modules, row-major.

name: digitsAt

name: NUpBorder
doc: A resolved N-up cell frame.

name: importMatrix

name: importPageAsXObject

name: placeFitted

name: rotateMatrix
doc: Clockwise rotation matrix about the origin (PDF /Rotate convention).

name: validatePlacement
doc: Validate `rect`/`rotate` placement options (shared by StampWith and Overlay).

name: placeXObject
doc: Place an already-imported Form-XObject `ref` onto `page`: register it under  the page's COW /Resources/XObject (fresh Fm key) and splice a positioned  `q [gs] <cm> /Fm Do Q` body, fitting the XObject /BBox onto `rect` (default  the page's CropBox) through any extra rotation.

name: stampWith
doc: Place `src` (a page from this or another Document) onto `page` as a shared  Form XObject, fitted to `opts.rect` (default the page's CropBox) and drawn as  an overlay (default) or underlay.

name: overlay
doc: Stamp a single source page onto many target pages of `doc`.

name: resolveNUpBorder
doc: Validate and resolve {@link NUpOptions.drawBorder}; undefined when no frame  is wanted.

name: checkRect
doc: Module-private: nothing outside template.ts validates a placement rect.

name: resizePage
doc: Set `page` MediaBox and CropBox to `box`.

name: scalePage
doc: Uniformly scale `page` by `factor > 0`: multiply every present boundary box  and wrap content in `factor 0 0 factor 0 0 cm`.

name: rc4

name: validateUserR234

name: hash2B

name: randomBytes

name: aesCbcEncrypt
doc: AES-CBC encrypt: a random 16-byte IV is prepended; PKCS#7 padding.

name: aesCbcEncryptNoPad
doc: AES-CBC encrypt with an explicit IV and NO padding (for /UE, /OE).

name: aes256EcbEncrypt

name: validateTemplate

name: imageAnchor

name: drawText

name: tokenValuesFor

name: usesLabel

name: imageWidthFor

doc: @internal Embed `data` ONCE and place the single shared Image XObject on each  page.

name: addWatermark

name: addHeaderFooter
doc: @internal Implementation of {@link Document.AddHeaderFooter}.

name: addBatesNumbering
doc: @internal Implementation of {@link Document.AddBatesNumbering}.

name: POSITIONS

properties.name: bytesSaved

name: tolerance
doc: Marker x positions this close are the same nesting level.

name: allCaps
doc: True when every cased letter is uppercase, over at least two letters.

name: readDocMdpLevel
doc: Read the certification level (`/P`) from a certification signature's value  dictionary via its `/Reference` DocMDP transform, or undefined when absent.

name: requiredLevel

name: addedLevel

name: modifiedLevel

name: widgetLevel
doc: A widget is `signing` (P≥2) when it is a signature field, else a form/annot  widget (P≥3).

name: streamLevel
doc: Appearance/image streams (P≥2) vs any other stream — e.g.

doc: A page may only gain/lose `/Annots`; classify the annotations added/removed.

name: fieldChangeLevel
doc: A field/widget change is form-fill/signing (P≥2) or an annotation-class edit  (P≥3); any other key change exceeds every level.

methods.doc: The document outline (bookmark) tree; [] when there is no /Outlines.

methods.name: pageRef
methods.doc: @internal The indirect ref for a 1-based page number; throws when that page  is not an indirect object.

methods.name: SetOutlines
methods.doc: Replace the document outline with `items`; an empty array removes it.

methods.name: GetPageLabels
methods.doc: The logical page-label ranges from /Root /PageLabels, ascending; [] when  there is no /PageLabels.

methods.name: SetPageLabels
methods.doc: Replace /Root /PageLabels with `labels`; an empty array removes it.

methods.name: PageLabelFor
methods.doc: Resolve a 0-based page index to its rendered label (prefix + numeral).

methods.name: GetNamedDestinations
methods.doc: All named destinations, merging the /Names /Dests name tree and the legacy  /Dests dict (legacy wins on a clash), sorted by name.

methods.name: SetNamedDestination
methods.doc: Upsert `name` → `dest` into the /Names /Dests name tree (creating the  containers as needed), writing a single flat node — no balanced-tree  rebalancing.

methods.name: RemoveNamedDestination
methods.doc: Remove `name` from both the name tree and the legacy /Dests dict, pruning  the now-empty containers.

methods.name: GetOpenAction
methods.doc: What this document does when it is opened: go to a view (`kind: 'dest'`)  or run an action (`kind: 'action'`).

methods.name: SetOpenDestination
methods.doc: Open the document at `dest`, written as a destination.

methods.name: SetOpenAction
methods.doc: Run `action` when the document is opened, written as an action dict.

methods.name: RemoveOpenAction
methods.doc: Remove the catalog /OpenAction.

methods.name: GetJavaScripts
methods.doc: Document-level JavaScript: every entry of the /Names /JavaScript tree,  sorted by name.

methods.name: SetJavaScript
methods.doc: Upsert a document-level script, run by the viewer when the document opens.

methods.name: RemoveJavaScript
methods.doc: Remove a document-level script.

methods.name: GetAttachments
methods.doc: All document-level embedded files (the /Names /EmbeddedFiles tree), sorted  by name.

methods.name: AddAttachment
methods.doc: Embed `bytes` as an attachment named `name`, upserting it into the  /Names /EmbeddedFiles name tree (overwriting a same-named entry).

methods.name: RemoveAttachment
methods.doc: Remove the named attachment from the name tree (and /AF).

methods.name: GetCollection
methods.doc: The /Root /Collection portfolio presentation settings, or undefined.

methods.name: SetCollection
methods.doc: Write (or replace) the /Root /Collection portfolio settings.

methods.name: RemoveCollection
methods.doc: Remove /Root /Collection.

methods.name: ensureInfo
methods.doc: @internal The /Info dictionary, created and linked from the trailer when  absent.

methods.name: SetXmp
methods.doc: Set/replace the document XMP packet from `update` (merged over the current  packet; `null` deletes a field), mirroring shared fields back into /Info.

methods.name: ClearMetadata
methods.doc: Remove all document metadata: drop the /Info dictionary and the catalog's  /Root /Metadata XMP packet, so /Info and XMP stay consistent (the mirror  counterpart of SetMetadata <-> SetXmp).

methods.name: Optimize
methods.doc: Losslessly shrink the document in place: subset already-embedded fonts to  the glyphs actually shown, merge byte-identical streams, and recompress  stream payloads.

methods.name: ConvertToGrayscale
methods.doc: Convert the document's colour to DeviceGray in place: page content, form  XObjects, tiling patterns, Type 3 glyph procedures, image XObjects,  shadings and annotations.

methods.name: Save
methods.doc: Serialize the live document to PDF bytes (mark-sweep from /Root, renumbered).

methods.name: AddFont
methods.doc: Parse and register a font program (TrueType/OpenType sfnt bytes), returning  a handle to pass as the `font` option to {@link Page.AddText} /  {@link Page.AddTextBlock}.

methods.name: AddFontFile
methods.doc: Read a font program from disk (synchronous) and register it; the file path  counterpart of {@link AddFont}, mirroring {@link WriteTo}.

methods.name: RegisterFontFolder
methods.doc: Search `dir`, recursively, when resolving a font by name.

methods.name: RegisterSystemFonts
methods.doc: Also search the platform's own font directories.

methods.name: ResolveFontByName
methods.doc: What `family` resolves to, without loading or embedding anything.

methods.name: LoadFontByName
methods.doc: The face matching `family`, registered and ready to draw with.

methods.name: LoadFontFamily
methods.doc: The four faces of `family`, ready to hand to `AddMarkdown({ style: { font } })`.

methods.name: Sign
methods.doc: Add an (invisible) digital signature.

methods.name: Certify
methods.doc: Add a *certification* (author) signature with a DocMDP transform: the  signature carries a `/Reference` DocMDP entry and the catalog gains  `/Perms /DocMDP` pointing at it, declaring which later changes are  permitted (`opts.permissions`, default `no-changes`).

methods.name: AddValidationData
methods.doc: Embed long-term-validation (LTV) data in a `/DSS` (PAdES-B-LT): for each  existing signature, store its certificate chain plus the OCSP/CRL bytes  returned by the `opts.getOCSP`/`opts.getCRL` callbacks, indexed by a `/VRI`  entry, and append the store as an incremental update (existing signatures  preserved verbatim).

methods.name: AddDocumentTimestamp
methods.doc: Append a document timestamp (`/DocTimeStamp`, ETSI.RFC3161) as an  incremental update, enabling PAdES-B-LTA archival on top of B-LT.

methods.name: VerifySignatures
methods.doc: Verify every signature in the document: recompute each `/ByteRange` digest,  verify the detached CMS, and diff what changed after each signature.

methods.name: VerifyDocumentTimestamps
methods.doc: Verify every document timestamp (`/DocTimeStamp`) in the document: check  each token's message-imprint binding to the `/ByteRange` and the TSA's CMS  signature, returning one {@link DocumentTimestampReport} per field.

methods.name: WriteTo
methods.doc: Serialize and write to a file path (synchronous), mirroring OpenFile.

methods.name: InsertPage
methods.doc: Insert a page so it becomes 1-based page `at` (1..Pages.length+1): a blank  page (of `source` when it is a {@link PageFormat}, else {@link PageFormat.A4}),  or a deep copy of `source` when it is a {@link Page} (from this or another  Document, keeping that page's own size).

methods.name: AddPage
methods.doc: Append a page: a blank page (of `source` when it is a {@link PageFormat},  else {@link PageFormat.A4}), or a deep copy of `source` when it is a  {@link Page}.

methods.name: NewFlow
methods.doc: Create a {@link Flow} layout container bound to this document.

methods.name: AddMarkdown

params.name: options

methods.doc: Render a whole Markdown document, appending freshly sized pages to the end  of this document.

methods.name: NewFloatingBox
methods.doc: Create a {@link FloatingBox} bound to this document.

methods.name: NewTilingPattern
methods.doc: Create a reusable tiling pattern (PDF PatternType 1): `draw` paints one  tile into a builder scoped to tile space, and the pattern repeats on an  `xStep` x `yStep` lattice wherever it is used.

methods.name: NewTemplate
methods.doc: Create a reusable template: a Form XObject you draw once and place on any  number of pages, allocated as a single object however often it is used.

methods.name: InsertPages
methods.doc: Insert every page of `other` so the first becomes 1-based page `at`  (1..Pages.length+1), shifting existing pages down.

methods.name: Append
methods.doc: Append every page of `other` to the end of this document.

methods.name: Merge
methods.doc: Build a new document from copies of all `docs`, in order.

methods.name: Redact
methods.doc: Redact regions on a single page (1-based `page` number); see `Page.Redact`.

methods.name: RedactText
methods.doc: Redact every occurrence of `find` across all pages; see `Page.RedactText`.

methods.name: MarkRedactText
methods.doc: Mark every occurrence of `find` across all pages; see `Page.MarkRedactText`.

methods.name: ApplyRedactions
methods.doc: Apply every /Redact mark across all pages; see `Page.ApplyRedactions`.

methods.name: ReplaceText
methods.doc: Replace every occurrence of `find` with `replacement` across all pages; see  `Page.ReplaceText`.

methods.name: Overlay
methods.doc: Stamp a single source page onto many pages of this document as one shared  Form XObject — letterheads, watermarks, backgrounds.

methods.name: AddWatermark
methods.doc: Stamp a repeating text or image watermark across a page range.

methods.name: AddHeaderFooter
methods.doc: Stamp header and/or footer text across a page range.

methods.name: AddBatesNumbering
methods.doc: Stamp a Bates sequence across a page range (bottom-right, `{bates}`, 10pt  by default).

methods.name: NUp
methods.doc: Impose this document's pages `cols`×`rows` per sheet into a **new**  Document (this one is unmodified, like Split/ExtractPages).

methods.name: Booklet
methods.doc: Impose this document's pages as a saddle-stitch booklet into a **new**  Document (this one is unmodified, like NUp/Split/ExtractPages).

methods.name: FlattenAnnotations
methods.doc: Flatten annotations on every page into static page content; see  `Page.FlattenAnnotations`.

methods.name: FlattenForm
methods.doc: Flatten the interactive form into static page content: generate every  field's appearance, bake each widget into its page at its /Rect, then drop  the document /AcroForm.

properties.name: Pages
properties.doc: One Page per page, in document order.

properties.name: recovery
properties.doc: Set when Open had to recover from a damaged cross-reference structure;  undefined after a clean parse.

name: hasXmpField
doc: True when `meta` carries at least one known (non-raw) XMP field.

name: startxrefIsUsable
doc: True when the file ends with a startxref whose value is a plausible offset  into it.

name: normalizeRecipient
doc: Resolve an OpenOptions.recipient into a private key + DER certificate.

name: assembleSinglePageDoc
doc: Wrap a renumbered single-page object set in a /Pages node + /Catalog.

name: offsetRefs

name: inheritedValue
doc: First ancestor value of `key` up `src`'s /Parent chain in `doc` (raw, not  resolved); null if none.

name: DocxOptions
doc: Options for {@link Document.ToDocx} and {@link Page.ToDocx}.

properties.name: backdrop

properties.name: box

name: sectPr

name: imageRegistry

name: collectPage

name: renderTextbox

name: render
doc: **Invariant:** the mode is branched on ONCE, here.

name: renderDocumentToDocx

name: renderPageToDocx
doc: Render one page to a `.docx`.

name: DocxImage

name: DocxImageSink

name: DocxLinkSink

name: FrameProps
doc: A positioned frame, in twips, anchored to the page.

name: Ctx
doc: Walk state: the sinks, the numbering allocated so far, the list nesting  depth, and the running drawing id.

name: sanitizeXml
doc: Drop the characters XML 1.0 forbids, keeping tab, newline and return.

name: textXml
doc: Text as `w:t` segments, line breaks as `w:br`.

name: headingLevel
doc: Heading level, or 0 for anything else.

name: inlineRuns
doc: Every text run under a node, flattened — the inline projection.

name: drawingXml
doc: One inline picture.

name: nodeBlocks
doc: Append `node`'s block XML to `out`.

name: listItemBlocks
doc: One item: its first block carries the marker, its remaining blocks are  indented siblings, and a nested list raises the level.

name: docxBody
doc: Map a document tree to the inner XML of `<w:body>`.

name: TextGroup
doc: One frame's worth of text: the glyphs sharing a baseline, a size, an  emphasis and a colour, with no gap wide enough to be a layout decision.

properties.name: quad
properties.doc: Page-space axis box [x0,y0,x1,y1] covering every glyph in the group.

properties.name: color
properties.doc: Absent when black — the fence `GlyphEvent.color` sets.

properties.name: skewed
properties.doc: True when any contributing glyph was rotated or vertically set.

properties.name: gapEm
properties.doc: Gap that starts a new group, as a multiple of the font size.

properties.name: baselineTol
properties.doc: Baseline difference tolerated within one group, as a multiple of the font  size.

name: continues

name: groupGlyphs
doc: Group consecutive glyphs into the runs a positioned frame will hold.

name: DocxExtras
doc: Parts and relationships a caller adds beside the minimal set — styles,  numbering, images.

name: documentXml
doc: The `word/document.xml` part.

name: writeDocx
doc: Write a minimal conformant `.docx` whose body is `bodyXml` — the inner XML  of `<w:body>`.

name: DocxNumbering
doc: One list the body emitted: its id, its kind, and its first ordinal.

name: docxStylesXml
doc: The `word/styles.xml` part.

name: abstractNum
doc: Nine levels of one list kind.

name: docxNumberingXml
doc: The `word/numbering.xml` part: two abstract definitions — bullet and  decimal — and one `w:num` per list the body emitted.

name: EMU_PER_PT
doc: Points to English Metric Units, and to twips.

name: STYLE
doc: The style ids the mapper may name.

name: BULLETS
doc: **Invariant:** real bullet characters in the document font, not Word's  conventional U+F0B7 in Symbol.

name: DocxTableCtx
doc: `paragraph` builds one `w:p` from cell text.

name: borderSz
doc: `w:sz` is in EIGHTHS of a point, and Word's accepted range is 2..96.

name: edgeXml
doc: One cell edge.

name: gridWidths
doc: Column widths in points, from every cell's left edge plus the table's right  edge.

name: coveredColumns
doc: The columns covered at `rowIndex` by a rowSpan started in an earlier row.

name: mergedCellXml
doc: A continuation cell for a rowSpan started above.

name: docxTable
doc: An extracted table as `w:tbl`.

name: ImagePlacement
doc: An image the package has already registered, and where the page drew it.

properties.name: quad
properties.doc: Page-space axis box [x0,y0,x1,y1] of the drawn image.

properties.name: box
properties.doc: Page-space sizing box [x0,y0,x1,y1] — CropBox, or MediaBox under box:'media'.

properties.name: backdrop
properties.doc: Page-sized backdrop image, emitted first so the frames stack above it.

name: frameFor
doc: A page-space quad as a page-anchored frame, in twips.

name: pictureFrame
doc: One picture in its own frame — the same `drawingXml` flow mode places  inline, wrapped rather than reimplemented.

name: pageFrames
doc: Every frame paragraph for one page, backdrop first.

name: docxTextboxBody
doc: Map positioned pages to the inner XML of `<w:body>`.

properties.name: skipped
properties.doc: Set when the pass declined to run; `removed` is then empty.

name: collectResourceRefs
doc: Every resource name a content fragment uses, as `Category/name` keys.

name: chargeUnresolved
doc: Charge to /DR every name `local` holds that `res` does not resolve.

name: collectDrReferences
doc: Every reference the document can make into /DR: each /DA string, and each name an /AP stream cannot resolve against its own /Resources.

name: reachableSet
doc: Object numbers reachable from /Root (+ /Info) — what `Save()` would write.

name: chargeKeptDrStreams
doc: A /DR entry can itself be a content stream — a form XObject, a tiling pattern — naming further /DR entries.

name: pruneDefaultResources
doc: Delete /AcroForm /DR entries nothing in the document can name, and the objects that leaves unreachable.

name: DR_CATEGORIES
doc: The /DR categories this pass prunes.

name: refKey
doc: A reference key.

name: ValidationDataOptions
doc: Options for {@link Document.AddValidationData}: callbacks that fetch the  OCSP response / CRL for each signer, plus any extra certificates to embed  (e.g.

name: DssEntry
doc: Per-signature validation data to embed under one `/VRI` entry.

name: dedupBlobs
doc: De-duplicate DER blobs by content, preserving first-seen order.

name: vriKey
doc: The `/VRI` key for a signature: the uppercase base-16 SHA-1 of its `/Contents`  value (the whole signature byte string, padding included).

name: valStream
doc: A bare stream carrying one DER validation object (cert / OCSP / CRL).

name: buildDss
doc: Build the `/DSS` object graph in `doc` and return its dictionary reference.

name: streamsOf
doc: Decode every validation stream referenced by `arr` (resolving refs, inflating  any FlateDecode).

name: readDssCerts
doc: All certificates embedded in the document's `/DSS` (top-level `/Certs`), DER.

name: readDssMaterial
doc: Read `/DSS` validation data into per-signature {@link RevocationMaterial},  keyed by signature field name.

name: ContentAddr
doc: Address of an operator within a page's content.

properties.name: path
properties.doc: XObject resource-name chain descended from the page; [] = top-level page content.

properties.name: opIndex
properties.doc: Index of the operator within that parsed stream.

name: EditableContent
doc: Editable per-stream view of a page's content (Phase 4 foundation, F1).

methods.name: setTopOps
methods.doc: Sets the top ops value.

methods.name: editedXObjectPaths
methods.doc: Paths of the Form XObjects copied-on-write so far (edited scopes).

methods.name: xobjectResources
methods.doc: The COW'd /Resources dict of an edited XObject scope, or undefined when it  has none of its own (inherits the parent's).

methods.name: ownXObjectResources
methods.doc: Force the copy-on-write of the Form XObject at `path` and return its own  /Resources, creating an empty one when the form has none.

methods.name: setXobjectOps
methods.doc: Sets the xobject ops value.

methods.name: commit
methods.doc: Write modified streams back into fresh page-owned stream objects.

name: contentStreams
doc: The resolved stream objects of a page's /Contents, in order.

name: AttachmentOptions
doc: Options shared by document-level attachments and FileAttachment annotations.

properties.name: mimeType
properties.doc: MIME type written to the embedded stream's /Subtype (e.g.

properties.doc: Human-readable description written to the filespec's /Desc.

properties.name: compress
properties.doc: Compress the bytes with FlateDecode on save.

name: Attachment
doc: A live handle over one embedded file's /Filespec.

methods.name: GetBytes
methods.doc: Decode the embedded bytes, inflating FlateDecode if present.

methods.name: GetField
methods.doc: Read a custom /CI field.

methods.name: SetField
methods.doc: Upsert a custom /CI field value.

methods.name: RemoveField
methods.doc: Remove a custom /CI field value, dropping /CI when only /Type remains.

name: buildFilespec
doc: Build a /Filespec dict over a freshly allocated /EmbeddedFile stream.

name: filespecName
doc: The filespec's display name, preferring the Unicode /UF over /F.

name: readFilespecBytes
doc: Decode the embedded bytes of a /Filespec, inflating FlateDecode if present.

name: encodeFieldValue
doc: Encode a /CI field value: string→PDF string, number→PDF number,  Date→PDF date string.

name: readFilespec
doc: Wrap a /Filespec in an Attachment handle, or undefined when not a dict.

name: readAttachments
doc: All document-level embedded files from /Root /Names /EmbeddedFiles, sorted.

doc: Add a filespec ref to the catalog's /AF associated-files array (PDF 2.0),  creating it on first use and de-duplicating by object number.

name: removeAssociatedFile
doc: Remove a filespec ref from /AF, dropping the array when it empties.

name: upsertEmbeddedFile
doc: Upsert `key` → `fsRef` into /Root /Names /EmbeddedFiles (single flat node,  no rebalancing) and register the filespec in /AF.

name: removeEmbeddedFile
doc: Remove `key` from /EmbeddedFiles (collapsing empty containers) and from /AF.

name: EmbeddedFont
doc: An opaque handle to a font program registered with {@link Document.AddFont}.

methods.doc: @internal Construct via {@link Document.AddFont}.

methods.doc: @internal Width of `text` in points at `fontSize`; chars absent from the  font's cmap are dropped (no recording).

methods.doc: @internal Encode `text` to 2-byte Identity-H glyph codes (CID = original  GID), recording each used GID for subsetting.

methods.name: probe
methods.doc: @internal Count of cmappable chars in `text`, without recording glyphs.

methods.name: driver
methods.doc: @internal A {@link FontDriver} view for the layout/stamping engine.

methods.name: shapeRuns
methods.doc: @internal Shape `text` into visual runs, recording used gids and, for each  final gid, the source code points of its cluster (for /ToUnicode).

methods.name: measureShaped
methods.doc: @internal Shaped width of `text` in points at `fontSize`.

properties.name: usedGids
properties.doc: @internal original GIDs (= CIDs) drawn with this font, across all pages.

properties.name: objNum
properties.doc: @internal object number of the Type0 font dict, reserved on first draw and  filled by the document's finalize pass at Save (undefined until then).

properties.name: shape

properties.name: toUnicode

name: glyphToUnicode
doc: Resolve an Adobe glyph name to a Unicode string, or undefined.

name: encodeWinAnsi
doc: Encode a JS string to WinAnsiEncoding bytes, dropping unrepresentable  codepoints (so callers never throw on a stray glyph).

name: baseEncodingByName

doc: Glyph names for a base encoding a font dict may name, or `undefined` when we have no table for it.

doc: WinAnsiEncoding: Latin-1 baseline (0x20..0xFF) with the CP1252 0x80..0x9F block.

name: standardEncodingNames
doc: StandardEncoding as glyph names.

name: computeU
doc: Algorithm 5: compute /U (32 bytes) for R3/R4.

doc: Read an FDF /Annots array into the neutral model.

name: fontStyleOf

name: parseType0VerticalWidths

name: resolveEncodingCMap

name: resolveSimpleEncoding
doc: Resolve a simple font's `/Encoding` without collapsing the unknowns.

name: glyphNameResolver

name: buildSimpleEncoding

name: std14Widths

name: parseSimpleWidths

return_type: { widths: Map<number, number>; missing: number; hasMissing: boolean } | undefined

name: buildProgramWidths

name: parseType0Widths

name: buildCidProgramWidths

name: Alloc

name: subsetTag

name: sanitizeName

name: buildW

name: utf16beHex

name: buildToUnicode

name: buildEmbeddedFont
doc: Build the PDF font object graph for one embedded font and return the Type0 font dict (descendant CIDFont, FontDescriptor, FontFile, /CIDToGIDMap, and /ToUnicode streams are allocated via `alloc`).

name: FaceStyle

properties.name: italic

name: StyleRequest

name: LoadFontOptions

properties.name: italic

name: FontMatch

properties.name: family

properties.name: subfamily

properties.name: weight

properties.name: exact

name: FontFamily

name: deriveStyle

name: clampWeight

name: familyMatches

name: matchFace

name: matchChain

name: FontNames

properties.name: typographicSubfamily

name: parseTableDirectory

doc: Read the naming and style fields from a whole sfnt buffer.

doc: Rewrite a `post` v2.0 table as v3.0: the same 32-byte header, without the  glyph-name index and string pool that follow it.

name: shrinkGlyf
doc: Sparse-shrink a glyf font: keep `numGlyphs` and GID numbering, blank the outlines of glyphs outside `keep` (closed over composite components), and drop DROP_TABLES.

name: emitSpan
doc: Re-emit one DICT span: its operands, then its operator.

name: charsetLength
doc: Byte length of a charset at `off`.

name: encodingLength
doc: Byte length of an Encoding at `off`.

name: shrinkNameKeyedCff
doc: Sparse-shrink a **name-keyed** CFF (`FontFile3` `/Subtype /Type1C`): keep `numGlyphs` and GID numbering, replace the charstrings of glyphs outside `keep` with a bare `endchar`, and re-assemble preserving every structure a simple font dict's code -> name -> GID chain runs through.

name: shrinkCff
doc: Sparse-shrink a CFF program: keep `numGlyphs` and GID numbering, replace the charstrings of glyphs outside `keep` with a bare `endchar`, and re-emit the original charset so CID->GID resolution is unchanged.

name: DROP_TABLES
doc: Tables carrying no information needed to render already-positioned text:  layout (GSUB/GPOS/GDEF/BASE/JSTF/kern), hinting/device metrics  (hdmx/VDMX/LTSH/gasp/PCLT), embedded bitmaps (EBDT/EBLC/CBDT/CBLC/sbix),  colour/vector extras (SVG /MATH), and the signature (DSIG).

name: FaceRecord

properties.name: faceIndex

name: systemFontFolders

name: readAt

name: ClipMask

name: gidForCode

name: drawGlyphPlaceholder

doc: Axial (type 2): project onto the axis and clamp/extend at the ends.

name: expandObjectStreams

name: rebuildTrailer

name: ObjCandidate

doc: Number of sample components per pixel for a colorspace we can lay out from the  image dict alone, or undefined when it can't be determined reliably (a bare  non-device name — e.g.

name: maskClearBit
doc: The non-marking stencil bit for an image mask: 1 under the default /Decode  [0 1] (sample 0 marks), 0 under /Decode [1 0] (sample 1 marks).

properties.name: deviceScale
properties.doc: Points per user unit at the placement.

properties.name: resolveImage
properties.doc: Caller-supplied bytes for an href the walker cannot decode itself.

name: DrawResult
doc: What the walker produces: a content stream, the resources it needs, and the  element names it could not render.

properties.name: rasterized
properties.doc: Distinct element names whose subtree was flattened to a bitmap, sorted.

methods.name: addInk
methods.doc: Fold one painted box, under `m`, into the ink union.

methods.name: child
methods.doc: A fresh emitter for a nested content stream — a pattern tile.

methods.name: subdoc
methods.doc: Fork for a nested SVG DOCUMENT — an <image> whose payload is SVG — not for  another stream of this one.

methods.name: setPaint
methods.doc: Sets the paint value.

methods.name: patKey
methods.doc: Register `d`, reusing an identical pattern; returns its resource key.

methods.name: xobjKey
methods.doc: Register `r` in THIS stream's /XObject; returns its resource key.

methods.name: gsKey
methods.doc: Reuse one /ExtGState per (ca, CA, soft mask, subtype); returns its resource  key.

properties.name: active
properties.doc: ids currently being expanded through <use>, to break reference cycles.

properties.name: activePatterns
properties.doc: Pattern ids currently being expanded, likewise.

properties.name: activeMasks
properties.doc: Mask ids currently being expanded, to break reference cycles.

properties.name: activeMarkers
properties.doc: Marker ids currently being expanded, to break reference cycles — a marker  whose own content carries the same marker.

properties.name: rasterized
properties.doc: Element names flattened to a bitmap.

properties.name: raster
properties.doc: Supplied by svgembed.ts when a filter can be rasterized at all.

properties.name: filterPx
properties.doc: Points per user unit at the placement, times the filter resolution  multiplier.

properties.name: resolveImage
properties.doc: Supplied by the caller through AddSVGOptions; see decodeImage.

properties.name: svgDepth
properties.doc: How many nested <image> SVG payloads deep this emitter is.

properties.name: svgForms
properties.doc: `${href}|${viewBox}` -> the nested SVG's form ref, shared walk-wide like  `images`.

properties.name: streams
properties.doc: Supplied by svgembed.ts: only it may allocate a stream.

properties.name: xobj
properties.doc: Image XObjects THIS stream referenced: key -> ref.

properties.name: images
properties.doc: href -> the ref and intrinsic size, walk-wide so a repeated data: URI is  embedded once.

properties.name: masks
properties.doc: canonical (alpha pattern + box) -> the mask group's ref, walk-wide so two  shapes sharing one ramp allocate one group.

properties.name: imageSink
properties.doc: Supplied by svgembed.ts: only it may allocate an image stream.

properties.name: ctms
properties.doc: Test-only: the CTM in effect at each painted shape, in paint order.

properties.name: viewport
properties.doc: The viewport, for userSpaceOnUse percentage resolution.

properties.name: fonts
properties.doc: Supplied by svgembed.ts, which is the only module that may allocate the  font objects a face needs.

properties.name: css
properties.doc: Per-element CSS declarations, from the whole-tree pre-pass.

properties.name: usedFonts
properties.doc: Font resource keys this stream's content referenced.

properties.name: ink
properties.doc: Union of everything this emitter painted, in its own space.

properties.name: wantInk
properties.doc: Gets or sets the want ink.

name: PaintPass
doc: One painting operation: the operators that set it up, and which of fill and  stroke it performs.

properties.name: ops
properties.doc: Colour, pattern, alpha and stroke-parameter operators, in order.

name: PaintOps
doc: The paint decision for one element: whether each of fill and stroke happens  at all, and the passes that perform them.

name: ServerPaint
doc: A resolved url() paint.

properties.name: alphaPattern
properties.doc: The grayscale alpha ramp, when the gradient's stop alphas differ.

properties.name: elem
properties.doc: The element name to report if the ramp has to be dropped.

name: emitSegs
doc: Emit path-construction operators for `segs`.

name: __canon
doc: A stable string for a PdfObject tree, used only for pattern equality.

name: indexIds
doc: Index every element carrying an id, so use/clipPath can resolve references.

name: gradientFor
doc: Resolve a `url(#id)` paint reference to a gradient paint, or null when it is  not a gradient element (which the caller reports, as it does today).

name: tilingFor
doc: Build the tiling pattern for one `<pattern>` element, painting its children  into a nested content stream.

name: paintServer
doc: Resolve a url() reference to a gradient or a tiling pattern.

name: maskGroup
doc: The luminosity mask group for one alpha ramp: a transparency-group Form  XObject painting `box` with the ramp's grayscale twin.

name: groupForm
doc: Paint `body` into its own transparency-group Form XObject and return its ref.

name: viewportBox
doc: The viewport rectangle in the element's OWN user space: the viewport corners  mapped back through `ctm`, axis-aligned.

name: needsOpacityGroup
doc: Whether `opacity` on this element must go through a transparency group.

name: maskFor
doc: The soft-mask group for one `<mask>` element: a transparency group holding  the mask's children, painted in the masked element's user space.

name: textMeasure
doc: The TextMeasure subtreeBBox needs.

name: resolvePaint
doc: Resolve `p` over `bbox` into paint operators.

name: paintShape
doc: Paint a shape's segments with `p`, emitting only the operators it needs.

name: markerFormFor
doc: The Form XObject for one `<marker>`, built once per (marker, stroke width).

name: paintMarkers
doc: Paint the markers for one shape, after its own ink and in the same q/Q scope,  so the element's transform applies and they sit above it.

name: urlRef
doc: The id in a `url(#id)` value, or undefined.

name: emitClip
doc: Emit the geometry of a <clipPath> followed by `W n`.

name: nestedViewBox
doc: The user-unit box a nested payload's content is expressed in: its viewBox,  else its own width/height.

name: nestedRect
doc: The viewport an <image> establishes for a nested payload.

name: nestedForm
doc: Build (or reuse) the Form XObject for a nested payload.

name: drawNestedSvg
doc: Place a nested SVG payload.

name: rasterizeFeImage
doc: Rasterize one feImage reference into a Surface over the region raster.

name: emitFiltered
doc: Rasterize `body`'s subtree over the filter region, run the graph, and emit  the result as an image.

name: emitFastFilter
doc: Emit a chain PDF can express exactly, instead of rasterizing it (1gg0.10.5).

name: textPathSegs
doc: The path data a textPath asks for: inline first, else a same-document  `<path>`.

name: startOffsetOf
doc: startOffset as a distance: a percentage of the path length, or a length.

name: applyTextPaths
doc: Map each textPath owner's glyphs onto its own geometry.

name: applyStylesheet
doc: Collect and compile the document's stylesheet, and resolve it against every  element.

name: buildResources
doc: The /Resources for one content stream.

name: drawSvg
doc: Render an `<svg>` tree to a content stream.

name: __ctmProbe
doc: Test-only: the CTM in effect at each painted shape, in paint order.

name: AddSVGOptions
doc: Options for {@link Page.AddSVGObject}.

properties.name: fit
properties.doc: Override the file's own preserveAspectRatio: 'meet' fits the drawing  inside the rect, 'slice' covers it, 'fill' stretches each axis  independently.

properties.name: font
properties.doc: Face to use for any font-family the Standard-14 set cannot supply — a  handle from {@link Document.AddFont}.

properties.name: filterScale
properties.doc: Resolution multiplier for a rasterized `<filter>`: a multiple of the  placed device size.

properties.name: resolveImage
properties.doc: Supply the bytes for an `<image>` or `<feImage>` href this library cannot  decode itself — a relative path, an `http:` URL, or a `data:` payload whose  bytes are not PNG or JPEG.

properties.name: tag
properties.doc: Tag the drawing into the logical structure tree (marked content).

properties.name: alt
properties.doc: Create a /Figure carrying this /Alt and tag the drawing into it.

properties.name: artifact
properties.doc: Mark the drawing as an /Artifact — decoration carrying no meaning.

name: AddSVGResult
doc: The outcome of {@link Page.AddSVGObject}.

properties.name: skipped
properties.doc: Distinct element names whose rendering was skipped or incomplete, sorted —  e.g.

properties.name: rasterized
properties.doc: Distinct element names whose subtree was flattened to a bitmap, sorted.

name: resolveViewBox
doc: The user-unit box the content is expressed in: the viewBox, else the root  width/height, else the target rect (an identity mapping).

name: fontProvider
doc: Builds the /Font subdictionary as faces are asked for.

name: streamSink
doc: The sink svgdraw.ts uses to turn a built content stream into a PDF object.

name: imageSink
doc: Allocates the Image XObject for an `<image>`, and its soft mask.

name: rasterSink
doc: Rasterizes the filtered subtree for an SVG `<filter>`.

name: addSvgObject
doc: Parse `data` as SVG and draw it into `rect` on `page`.

name: FilterPrim
doc: One filter primitive, with its inputs resolved to keys.

properties.name: in1
properties.doc: Resolved key of the first input: 'SourceGraphic', 'SourceAlpha', or a  result name.

properties.name: in2
properties.doc: Resolved key of the second input; '' for a one-input primitive.

properties.name: result
properties.doc: The key this primitive's output is stored under.

properties.name: sub
properties.doc: Subregion, in the element's user space (y-down).

properties.name: node
properties.doc: The element itself, for primitives that read children (feMerge,  feComponentTransfer).

name: FilterSpec
doc: A resolved <filter>: where it applies and what to run inside it.

properties.name: region
properties.doc: The filter region, in the element's user space (y-down).

properties.name: res
properties.doc: filterRes, when given: a hard cap on the raster in device pixels.

properties.name: paint
properties.type: : { fill: Rgb | null; stroke: Rgb | null }
properties.doc: The element's own paint, for the FillPaint/StrokePaint pseudo-inputs.

name: FilterResolution
doc: A discriminated union rather than a nullable spec: the three outcomes are  genuinely different, and a caller that cannot tell 'renders nothing, as  asked' from 'cannot run this' will report one as the other.

name: FastPath
doc: A chain PDF can express EXACTLY, so it never reaches the rasterizer.

name: primInputs
doc: Every input key a primitive actually reads.

params.name: p
params.type: { name: string; node: XmlNode; in1: string; in2: string }

name: pseudoOk
doc: Whether a pseudo-input can actually be produced for THIS element.

name: validConvolve
doc: Whether an feConvolveMatrix's order/kernelMatrix/target agree.

name: validImageHref
doc: An feImage href this stack can resolve: '#id', a data: URI, or — when the  caller supplied a resolveImage — any non-empty href.

name: filterRes
doc: `filterRes`, when it parses to two positive numbers.

name: clipTo
doc: Intersect a subregion with the filter region.

name: subregion
doc: The x/y/width/height subregion of one primitive.

name: primLength
doc: A length-valued primitive parameter -- stdDeviation, dx, radius -- under the  filter's primitiveUnits.

name: floodPaint
doc: flood-color x flood-opacity, or null when the flood paints nothing.

name: resolveFilter
doc: Resolve one `<filter>` against the element it filters.

name: Surface
doc: A window onto the filter region, in device pixels.

name: PixelBox
doc: A subregion measured in raster pixels rather than user units.

name: ConvolveParams
doc: feConvolveMatrix's parsed parameters, or null when the element is malformed  — a kernel whose length disagrees with `order` cannot be guessed at.

name: toSurface
doc: Straight-alpha sRGB bytes from the rasterizer -> premultiplied linear.

name: flipRows
doc: Reverse the row order of a raster.

name: convertSpace
doc: Reinterpret a surface's colour channels in the other transfer function.

name: surfaceImage
doc: The pipeline's output end: premultiplied linear -> an Image XObject plus its  /SMask, in sRGB straight-alpha bytes.

name: maskTo
doc: Zero everything outside `win`.

name: sourceAlpha
doc: Black at the source's alpha.

name: floodKernel
doc: SVG 1.1 §15.7.10: flood-color x flood-opacity, in the primitive's own  working space -- runFilter converts the result back to linear afterwards.

name: over
doc: Source-over composite of `src` onto `dst`, in place.

name: blendKernel
doc: SVG 1.1 §15.7.4's five modes, written in the spec's own PREMULTIPLIED form  rather than routed through blend.ts — that module takes non-premultiplied  Rgb and returns the blend function alone, without the qa/qb weighting these  formulas fold in.

name: colorMatrixValues
doc: The 20-value matrix a feColorMatrix `type` stands for.

name: colorMatrixKernel
doc: SVG 1.1 §15.7.6: operates on NON-premultiplied values.

name: transferFn
doc: One feFuncR/G/B/A as a 0..1 -> 0..1 function.

name: componentTransferKernel
doc: SVG 1.1 §15.7.7: operates on NON-premultiplied values, like feColorMatrix.

name: boxSize
doc: SVG 1.1 §15.17's box-size formula: d = floor(s * 3 * sqrt(2*PI) / 4 + 0.5).

name: boxBlur1D
doc: One horizontal or vertical box blur of width `d`, on premultiplied data.

name: gaussian1D
doc: A true Gaussian convolution, for the small sigmas where three box blurs are  visibly boxy.

name: blurAxis
doc: Blur one axis by `sigma` PIXELS.

name: stdDev
doc: The two stdDeviation numbers, already scaled to pixels.

name: morphologyKernel
doc: SVG 1.1 §15.7.13: per-channel min (erode) or max (dilate) over the kernel  rectangle, on premultiplied values.

name: tileKernel
doc: SVG 1.1 §15.7.19: repeat the INPUT primitive's subregion across this  primitive's.

name: turbulenceParams
doc: feTurbulence's parameters, in USER units — the generator maps back to user  space itself, so nothing here is scaled to pixels.

name: lightSourceOf
doc: The <feDistantLight>/<fePointLight>/<feSpotLight> child, if any.

name: planeSurface
doc: An infinite plane of one solid colour (SVG 1.1 15.7.3), as a full-region  surface.

name: runFilter
doc: Evaluate the primitive graph over a rasterized source.

properties.name: color
properties.doc: lighting-color, 0..1 in the primitive's working space.

name: surfaceNormal
doc: The surface normal at (x, y), from the alpha channel read as a height field.

name: lightAt
doc: The light vector L at a surface point, and the light's own weight.

properties.name: baseFreqX
properties.doc: Per USER unit, not per pixel.

properties.name: fractalSum
properties.doc: type="fractalNoise" sums SIGNED noise; type="turbulence" sums |noise|.

properties.name: tile
properties.type: : { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number }
properties.doc: The primitive subregion, in user units — the stitch tile.

properties.name: width
properties.doc: Lattice cells per tile, per axis.

name: random
doc: The spec's Park–Miller generator, written to avoid overflow past 2**31.

name: noise2
doc: One octave of 2-D Perlin noise for one colour channel.

name: stitchFreq
doc: The base frequency adjusted so the tile holds a whole number of lattice  cells.

name: turbulence
doc: Sum the octaves at one point.

name: turbulenceSurface
doc: Generate premultiplied linear RGBA over `win`.

params.name: win
params.type: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number }

name: ResolvedGradient
doc: A gradient element with its href chain already flattened.

properties.name: attrs
properties.doc: Own attributes, with anything unset filled in from the href chain.

properties.name: stops
properties.doc: Raw stops in document order, before normalization.

name: GradientPaint
doc: What a gradient reference resolves to for one shape.

name: Axis
doc: How a length attribute resolves: against the viewport width, height, or  SVG's normalized diagonal.

name: parseOffset
doc: An `offset`: a number, or a percentage.

name: ownStops
doc: The stops declared directly on one gradient element.

name: resolveGradient
doc: Flatten a gradient's `href` / `xlink:href` chain: stops are inherited when the  child declares none, and each attribute when unset on the child.

name: bboxMatrix
doc: The objectBoundingBox coordinate system: equivalent to  translate(bx, by) scale(bw, bh).

name: patternMatrix
doc: The pattern /Matrix: gradient space -> the Form XObject's default space.

name: patternOf
doc: Assemble the pattern dict around a shading dict.

name: gradientPaint
doc: Map one gradient element onto a paint for one shape.

name: gradientSpaceCorners
doc: The bbox's four corners mapped into gradient space, or null when the box is  absent or `m` is singular.

name: spreadRange
doc: The integer repetition range [k0, k1] a linear gradient's axis must span to  cover `bbox`, in gradient space.

name: radialSpreadRange
doc: The number of ramp repetitions `k` a radial gradient needs to cover `bbox`.

name: tileStops
doc: n copies of a normalized stop list packed into [0, 1].

name: ImagePayload
doc: A decoded `<image>` payload: a raster ready to embed, or SVG bytes for the  walker to recurse into.

name: ImagePlacement
doc: Where one <image> lands, in the walker's y-down space.

properties.name: cm
properties.doc: The `cm` for the image's unit square.

properties.name: box
properties.doc: The fitted box, for the pattern-overflow ink union.

properties.name: clip
properties.doc: The element rect to clip to.

name: dataUriBytes
doc: The payload of a `data:` URI, or undefined for anything else — another  scheme, or a URI with no comma.

name: tryBuild
doc: Build an Image XObject from bytes, or undefined when they are unusable.

name: decodeImage
doc: Decode an `<image>` href into an Image XObject, or undefined when it cannot  be embedded.

name: looksLikeXml
doc: True when the bytes open with XML rather than a raster's magic number.

name: decodePayload
doc: Decode an `<image>` href into either a raster XObject or SVG bytes to recurse  into, or undefined when neither is available.

name: imageSize
doc: The image's intrinsic pixel size, off the XObject dict the build produced.

name: imagePlacement
doc: Resolve an <image>'s rect and fit against an intrinsic size of `iw` x `ih`.

name: MarkerVertex
doc: One marker position: where, which way, and which of the three properties  paints there.

name: Node
doc: A vertex with the tangents on either side, before kinds are assigned.

name: MarkerSpec
doc: A resolved <marker>: its viewport, content fit, reference point and orient.

properties.name: content
properties.doc: The viewBox -> viewport fit applied to the content; identity with none.

properties.name: clip
properties.doc: The clip rect in the marker's own CONTENT space, or null under  overflow: visible.

properties.name: refX
properties.doc: refX / refY, already mapped through `content` into viewport space.

properties.name: orient
properties.doc: A fixed angle in RADIANS, or one of the two auto modes.

name: unit
doc: The direction from `a` to `b` as a unit vector, or null when they coincide.

name: nodes
doc: The vertices a path visits, with their in/out tangents.

name: bisect
doc: The bisector of two unit directions, as an angle in radians.

name: markerVertices
doc: Every marker position on a path, with tangent angles.

name: resolveMarker
doc: Resolve one `<marker>`.

name: markerMatrix
doc: The placement for one vertex, composing (in mul's "m followed by n" order):  *    content -> translate(-ref) -> scale(sw) -> rotate(theta) -> translate(vertex)  *  The ref translate comes BEFORE the rotation, so the marker turns about its  reference point and that point stays pinned to the vertex at every angle.

name: MaskSpec
doc: A resolved <mask>: where it applies, how its content is interpreted, and  which PDF soft-mask subtype it becomes.

properties.name: region
properties.doc: The mask region, in the masked element's user space.

name: resolveMask
doc: Resolve one `<mask>` against the element it masks.

name: SvgSeg
doc: One normalized path segment.

methods.name: flag
methods.doc: An arc flag is a single '0' or '1' and may carry no separator at all  ("a1 1 0 011 1"), so it cannot go through num().

name: SegBBox
doc: An axis-aligned box in the coordinate system the segments are expressed in.

name: TextMeasure
doc: Measure a <text> element's ink.

name: arcToCubics
doc: Convert an endpoint-parameterized elliptical arc to a list of cubics  (SVG 1.1 F.6.5).

name: parsePath
doc: Parse SVG path data into normalized segments.

name: rectSegs
doc: A `<rect>` as segments.

name: ellipseSegs
doc: An `<ellipse>` (or `<circle>`, with rx === ry) as four cubics.

name: polySegs
doc: A `<polyline>` (close false) or `<polygon>` (close true) from a flat  [x0, y0, x1, y1, …] list.

name: parsePoints
doc: Parse a `points` attribute.

name: cubicExtrema
doc: The parameters in (0, 1) where a cubic's derivative vanishes on one axis.

name: segsBBox
doc: The TIGHT bounding box of normalized segments, in their own coordinate system:  endpoints plus each cubic's exact per-axis extrema.

name: shapeSegs
doc: The segments a shape element contributes, or [] when it draws nothing.

name: foldBox
doc: Fold `b`, mapped through `m`, into the running union.

name: subtreeBBox
doc: An element's bounding box, for `objectBoundingBox` units.

name: attrNum
doc: One numeric attribute, falling back to `dflt` when absent or unparseable.

name: ResolvedPattern
doc: A pattern flattened through its href chain: the effective attributes, and  the element whose children supply the tile content.

name: tileRect
doc: The tile rect in the enclosing user space, or null when it has no area —  which SVG says means the element is simply not rendered by that paint.

name: tileMatrix
doc: The pattern `/Matrix` and the transform the tile's own content needs.

properties.name: box
properties.doc: Which page box defines the viewport.

name: SvgWriter
doc: Accumulates SVG body markup plus a <defs> section with unique ids.

name: SvgSink
doc: RenderSink that emits a standalone SVG document.

methods.name: setAlpha
methods.doc: Sets the alpha value.

methods.name: setBlend
methods.doc: Sets the blend value.

params.name: _region
params.type: { x0: number; y0: number; x1: number; y1: number }

name: fmt
doc: Format a number for SVG output: fixed to ≤4 dp, trailing zeros stripped.

name: escapeXml
doc: Escape the five XML predefined entities (`&` first to avoid double-encoding).

name: blendCss
doc: PDF /BM name → CSS mix-blend-mode keyword (CamelCase → lowercase-hyphenated).

name: pathToD
doc: Serialize a structured Path to an SVG `d` string (absolute M/L/C/Z), with  every point mapped through `m` into device space.

name: uniformScale
doc: Uniform device-space scale of an affine matrix, for mapping user-space  lengths (stroke width, dash) when a stroke's geometry is baked to device  space.

name: polyToD
doc: One closed device-space polygon (flat [x,y,...]) as an SVG subpath.

name: renderPageToSvg
doc: Render one page to a standalone SVG string.

name: Paint
doc: A resolved paint state.

name: parseColor
doc: Parse an SVG colour.

name: parsePaint
doc: A paint value, which may be a url() reference with an optional fallback.

name: parseInlineStyle
doc: Declarations from an inline `style=""`, lower-cased property names, split by  importance so the cascade can rank them separately.

name: styleGetter
doc: One element's property lookup, in CSS 2.1 cascade order:  *    inline !important  >  sheet !important  >  inline  >  sheet  >  attribute  *  Presentation attributes sit at the BOTTOM: CSS treats them as specificity-0  declarations at the start of the author stylesheet, so any matching rule  outranks them.

name: resolveStyle
doc: Resolve one element's paint over its parent's.
return_type: { paint: Paint; refs: string[]; groupOpacity: number }

name: INITIAL
doc: SVG's initial values.

name: SvgFace
doc: One resolved face, ready to measure, encode and reference.

properties.name: key
properties.doc: Resource key within the Form XObject's /Font subdictionary.

properties.name: outline
properties.type: : (ch: string, m: Matrix, tol: number) => Poly[] | null
properties.doc: `ch`'s contours, flattened under `m` (em units, y-up → user space), or  null when the face has no glyph for it.

name: SvgFontProvider
doc: Resolves a CSS font-family list to a usable face, registering it on demand.

methods.doc: Every face registered so far, keyed by resource name.

name: FamilyMatch
doc: Which Standard-14 family a family list asks for, and whether anything in the  list actually matched.

name: SvgTextStyle
doc: One element's resolved text properties.

properties.name: baselineShift
properties.doc: Em fraction added to the baseline, positive up.

name: SvgChar
doc: One addressable character, with its positioning-list entries resolved.

properties.name: chain
properties.doc: The owning element chain, outermost first, as indices into  FlatText.owners.

name: TextPathSpec
doc: A `<textPath>`'s own attributes, recorded on its owner.

properties.name: href
properties.doc: Same-document id from href / xlink:href, '#' stripped.

properties.name: startOffset
properties.doc: Raw attribute text, resolved against the path length at map time so a  percentage does not need the geometry here.

properties.name: stretch
properties.doc: method="stretch": warp the glyph outlines instead of placing glyphs.

name: PosLists
doc: One element's positioning lists, kept aside during the walk because they can  only be applied after whitespace trimming has settled which characters  exist.

properties.name: css
properties.doc: Per-element stylesheet declarations, keyed by node identity.

name: PlacedGlyph
doc: One glyph, positioned in y-down user units.

properties.name: adv
properties.doc: The advance consumed after this glyph, spacing included.

properties.name: chunk
properties.doc: Anchored-chunk index: text-anchor applies per chunk, not per element.

name: TextSink
doc: What svgtext.ts needs from the walker: an operator sink and paint setup.

methods.doc: Emit the colour or pattern operators for `p` over `bbox`, and report  whether fill and stroke should actually be painted.

name: parseFamilies
doc: Split a CSS font-family list into lower-cased, unquoted names.

name: std14Face
doc: The Standard-14 face name for a family plus weight and style.

name: textMatrix
doc: The text matrix placing a glyph run at (x, y) rotated `deg` degrees.

name: pathOwnerOf
doc: The innermost textPath owner in `chain`, or null when the character is not  inside one.

name: baselineShift
doc: The baseline shift for `dominant-baseline`, as an em fraction, positive up.

name: applyLists
doc: Resolve every character's x/y/dx/dy/rotate from its ancestors' lists.

name: flattenText
doc: Flatten a <text> subtree to addressable characters.

name: placeChars
doc: Walk the cursor over the flattened characters.

name: applyTextLength
doc: Redistribute each textLength-declaring element's characters to span exactly  the requested length.

name: applyAnchors
doc: Shift each anchored chunk per the text-anchor in force at its first  character.

name: glyphsBBox
