name: sameRun
doc: True when two glyphs can share one Tm and one show operator.

name: showOps
doc: The show operator for one run: a single Tj when every glyph sits at its  natural advance, else a TJ carrying the differences.

name: decorationOps
doc: Decoration rules for a laid-out run, as content operators in y-down units.

name: emitGlyphs
doc: Emit BT/ET bodies for `glyphs`.

name: PathMetrics
doc: A path flattened to a polyline, with the cumulative arc length at each  vertex.

name: measurePath
doc: Flatten `segs` to a polyline and accumulate its arc length.

name: pointAt
doc: The point and tangent at `dist` along `m`, or null when `dist` falls outside  [0, total] or the path has no extent.
return_type: { x: number; y: number; angle: number } | null

name: reverseMetrics
doc: The same geometry traversed backwards — what side="right" means.

name: placeAt
doc: The point at `d` along `m`, displaced `perp` along the normal — the whole of  what "put something on this path" means here.
return_type: { x: number; y: number; angle: number } | null

name: mapGlyphsToPath
doc: Map every glyph `onPath` accepts onto `m`, leaving the rest untouched.

name: StretchedRun
doc: One warped run: contours in the <text> element's user space, plus the style  whose paint fills them.

name: canStretch
doc: Whether every glyph `onPath` selects can supply an outline, and there is at  least one.

name: stretchGlyphs
doc: Warp every glyph `onPath` selects onto `m`.

name: warpPoly
doc: One contour warped onto the path as an M/L/.../Z subpath, or null when the  path has no extent (placeAt cannot answer).

name: ViewBox
doc: A parsed `viewBox`.

name: BoxFit
doc: How a source box maps onto a destination box under a preserveAspectRatio.

name: parseTransform
doc: Parse a `transform` attribute into a single matrix.

name: parseViewBox
doc: Parse a `viewBox`.

name: unitLength
doc: Resolve one length under SVG's two unit systems.

name: frac
doc: The align fraction for one axis: 0 for Min, 0.5 for Mid, 1 for Max.

name: fitBox
doc: Fit `src` into `dest` under `par` (a preserveAspectRatio value) unless `fit`  overrides it.

name: placementMatrix
doc: Map `vb` onto `rect` = [x, y, w, h], honouring `par` (a preserveAspectRatio  value) unless `fit` overrides it, and flipping the y axis on the way.

name: viewBoxFitDown
doc: Map `vb` into a `w` x `h` box at the origin, in the y-DOWN frame svgdraw.ts  emits in — the same fit as placementMatrix, without its y flip.

name: rulesFromPath
doc: A single painted path's segments, reduced to horizontal/vertical rules.

name: clusterRules
doc: Merge rules whose `pos` is within SNAP AND whose lo..hi spans overlap or  nearly touch, unioning their spans.

name: assembleTable
doc: Build one Table from clustered rules + fragments within its region.

name: ruleBbox
doc: Union of all rule extents → a page-space bbox.

name: buildRuledRegion
doc: Build a ruled table for `bbox`, detecting tables nested inside cells  (arbitrary depth) by classifying rules as structural (span >= SPAN_FRAC of  the table extent) or confined, then qualifying each container cell's confined  rules as a nested table.

name: crosses
doc: True if a horizontal and a vertical rule physically cross (within SNAP).

name: partitionRules
doc: Partition page rules into connected stroke components: rules are joined when  a horizontal and a vertical rule cross, and connectivity propagates.

name: pathCenterlines
doc: Page-space centerline segments of a painted path: stroked segments as-is;  a thin filled rectangle collapsed to its centerline by its page-space AABB.

name: collectOriented
doc: One content walk collecting page-space centerline segments and text glyphs.

name: classifyRules
doc: Classify oriented centerline segments into clustered axis-aligned rules  (identical rule math to `rulesFromPath`'s stroke branch).

name: buildTables
doc: The ruled + whitespace build core, shared by the axis and rotated branches.

name: decorateInk
doc: Attach recovered borders and shading to every cell of `tables`, recursing  into nested tables.

name: BorderInfo
doc: A cell/table border: stroke width (pt), RGB colour (0..1), optional dash, and  which edges to paint.

name: Padding
doc: Inner cell padding: one value for every side, or an object naming the sides  that differ.

name: ResolvedPadding
doc: Padding with every side settled to a number.

name: CellTextOptions
doc: Per-cell/row text + visual style; each field falls back through the cascade  (cell ??

properties.name: underline
properties.doc: Rule below the baseline of the cell's text.

properties.name: textBackground
properties.doc: Fill behind the cell's *text* (text-tight, per line).

properties.name: padding
properties.doc: Inner padding, scalar or per side.

name: TableDefaults
doc: Table-level defaults; the cascade root, plus table-only fields.

name: ColumnWidth
doc: A column-width spec: an absolute width in points (`fixed`), or a share of the  leftover space after fixed columns are allotted (`fraction`).

name: CellHeader
doc: How a cell is marked in a tagged table: a /TH carrying the given /Scope, or a  /TD.

name: CellOptions
doc: `addCell` options: the per-cell text style plus an optional horizontal span.

properties.name: colSpan
properties.doc: Number of columns this cell spans.

properties.name: rowSpan
properties.doc: Number of rows this cell spans.

properties.name: header
properties.doc: Emit this cell as a /TH rather than a /TD when the table is drawn with  `{ tagged: true }`.

name: RowOptions
doc: `addRow` options: the row-level text style plus row-only geometry.

properties.name: minHeight
properties.doc: Floor for the row's laid height in points, before pagination.

name: CellImageOptions
doc: `setImage` options: image sizing, placement, and opacity for a cell image.

properties.name: height
properties.doc: Explicit image content height in points; default aspect-fit to inner width.

properties.name: align
properties.doc: Horizontal placement in the cell box; default the cell's resolved align.

properties.name: valign
properties.doc: Vertical placement in the cell box; default the cell's resolved valign.

properties.name: alt
properties.doc: Alt text for the /Figure this image gets when the table is drawn with  `{ tagged: true }`.

properties.name: artifact
properties.doc: Mark this image as an /Artifact when the table is drawn with  `{ tagged: true }` — decoration that carries no meaning and gets no  /Figure.

name: TableMetrics
doc: Measurement result for a table at given resolved column widths.

properties.name: cellLines
properties.doc: `cellLines[row][col]` = the wrapped line texts of that cell.

properties.name: grid
properties.doc: @internal The occupancy grid this measurement was taken against.

name: ResolvedStyle
doc: A cell's fully-resolved style (no undefined text fields).

name: CellPiece
doc: @internal One piece of a cell's content with the font it measures at.

name: CellBuilder
doc: One cell in a table row: a text string, optional per-cell style, and how many  columns it spans.

methods.name: setImage
methods.doc: Embed `data` (JPEG/PNG) in this cell, aspect-fit to the cell box.

properties.name: image
properties.type: : { built: BuiltImage; width: number; height: number; opts: CellImageOptions }
properties.doc: A cached cell image (from {@link setImage}) with intrinsic pixel size, or  undefined.

name: RowBuilder
doc: One row: an ordered list of cells plus an optional row-level style.

methods.name: constructor
methods.doc: @internal Use {@link TableBuilder.addRow}.

methods.name: setMinHeight
methods.doc: Set this row's height floor in points: the row lays out at  `max(n, content height)`, so content that needs more still wins.

methods.name: addCell
methods.doc: Append a cell.

name: TableBuilder
doc: A page-independent table: ordered rows over shared text defaults.

methods.name: constructor
methods.doc: @internal Use {@link createTable}.

methods.name: addRow
methods.doc: Append a row with an optional row-level `style` and `minHeight`.

methods.name: setColumnWidths
methods.doc: Set per-column widths as `fixed` points or `fraction`s of the leftover  space.

methods.name: autoFitColumns
methods.doc: Size columns from their content rather than splitting the width equally:  proportional to each column's widest unwrapped line, floored at its widest  single word, falling back to equal shares when even the floors do not fit.

methods.name: setRepeatingRowsCount
methods.doc: Repeat the first `n` rows at the top of every continuation page (`n = 0`  disables).

methods.name: continuationFrom
methods.doc: @internal Build a continuation table of the rows left after `startRow`:  shares this table's `defaults` and normalized column specs, carries the  original column count, and holds the same RowBuilder references (never  mutated).

methods.name: resolveColumnWidths
methods.doc: Resolve the column specs (from {@link setColumnWidths}, or equal columns if  unset) plus a `totalWidth` in points into concrete per-column widths.

methods.name: measure
methods.doc: Measure the table's natural laid-out height given resolved `columnWidths`  (points).

name: borderEdgeCount
doc: How many of a border's edges are painted.

name: padSide
doc: One side's value at a single cascade level, or undefined if unset there.

name: resolvePadding
doc: Resolve padding side by side down `levels` (nearest first), falling back to  the built-in 2pt.

name: measuringDriverFor
doc: A {@link FontDriver} that measures/wraps like the real font but records no  glyph usage — `encode` returns empty bytes, which measurement ignores.

name: sliceWidth
doc: Width of the concatenated pieces' [from, to) slice, measured piece by piece  so each keeps its own font.

name: cellExtents
doc: The widest single LINE (max-content) and widest single WORD (min-content) of  a cell's content, in points, excluding padding.

name: autoFitWidths
doc: Distribute `total` across columns from their measured content.

name: resolveCellStyle
doc: Resolve a cell's style: cell ??

name: checkPadding
doc: Validate a {@link Padding}.

name: validateStyleOpts
doc: Validate the cascadable style fields shared by table/row/cell.

name: normColumnWidth
doc: Validate one column-width spec and return a normalized single-key copy, so  later discrimination via `'fixed' in w` is reliable.

name: createTable
doc: Create a table with optional shared defaults (text style, alignment, border,  background, padding, outer border), each overridable per row/cell.

name: cellText
doc: A cell's text: its fragments assembled into lines by baseline, each line  left-to-right with a space inserted across a gap wider than a quarter em.

name: rowBbox
doc: The bounding box of a row's cells.

name: buildCells
return_type: { row: number; col: number; rowSpan: number; colSpan: number; quad: Rect }[]

name: InkEdge
doc: One drawn axis-aligned edge, in page space.

name: InkFill
doc: A filled rectangle too fat to be a rule — a candidate cell or table  background.

name: deviceSegments
doc: Flatten a path's subpaths to device-space line segments.

name: collectPageInk
doc: Index a page's painted paths as axis-aligned edges and candidate background  fills.

name: edgeAt
doc: The edge drawn along a cell side, or undefined when none is.

name: fillUnder
doc: The background fill of a cell rect, or undefined when none matches.

name: CellBorder
doc: One drawn cell edge.

properties.name: isHeader
properties.doc: Tagged path only: true for a `TH` cell.

properties.name: id
properties.doc: Tagged path only: the element's `/ID`, for header association.

properties.name: headers
properties.doc: Tagged path only: `/Headers` — ids of the header cells that describe this cell.

properties.name: borders
properties.doc: The cell's drawn edges, when they could be recovered.

properties.name: shading
properties.doc: The cell's recovered background, absent when none was found.

name: Table
doc: A reconstructed table: a rows×cells model with page-space quads and text,  serializable to HTML or Markdown.

properties.name: angle
properties.doc: Rotation of the table in radians; 0 for axis-aligned.

name: cellStyle
doc: Inline style for a recovered cell, or '' when the cell was not recovered.

name: normalize
doc: Wrap `a` into (-period/2, period/2].

name: modeAngle
doc: Weighted modal angle over [0, period): 1° bins, then the weighted mean of the  modal bin and its immediate neighbours, normalised to (-period/2, period/2].

name: dominantAngle
doc: Dominant rotation angle (radians).

name: ANGLE_EPS
doc: ~0.29°: below this, a page is treated as axis-aligned.

name: AddTableOptions
doc: Options for {@link drawTable} / `page.AddTable`.

properties.name: width
properties.doc: Total table width in points; feeds resolveColumnWidths.

properties.name: cellPadding
properties.doc: Inner padding per cell in points, standing in for the table style's  `padding` (default 2).

properties.name: autoPaginate
properties.doc: Append pages (sized to the anchor page) and draw the whole table.

properties.name: bottomMargin
properties.doc: Stop line, in points above each page's CropBox bottom edge: a row is drawn  only while it fits above `CropBox.y0 + bottomMargin`.

properties.name: topMargin
properties.doc: Continuation start, in points below an appended page's CropBox top edge:  each new page starts at `CropBox.y1 - topMargin`.

properties.name: tagged
properties.doc: Emit /Table + /TR + /TD logical structure into the document structure tree.

name: AddTableResult
doc: The outcome of {@link drawTable} / `page.AddTable`.

properties.name: endY
properties.doc: The y of the bottom edge of the last drawn row on the last page (equals  `top` when nothing was drawn).

properties.name: remainder
properties.doc: Rows that did not fit, as a re-drawable TableBuilder.

properties.name: struct
properties.doc: The /Table element, when `tagged` and at least one row was drawn.

name: Placed
doc: A placed cell: page-space rect (top-left origin uses `bottom`), text, style.

properties.name: image
properties.type: : { built: BuiltImage; width: number; height: number; opts: CellImageOptions }

properties.name: struct
properties.doc: The /TD or /TH this cell's text is tagged into.

properties.name: figure
properties.doc: The /Figure this cell's image is tagged into.

name: BlockRect
doc: A page block's outer rectangle for the table border.

name: strokeBorderBox
doc: Stroke `border` around the box `(x, bottom, w, h)` into `g`, honouring its  `sides`.

name: rangeIndices
doc: The contiguous index list `[start, start+1, ..., end-1)`.

name: placeRows
doc: Place the cells of the rows named by `rowIndices` (in the given order) with  the first row's top at `top`, stacking downward.

name: paintPlaced
doc: Paint placed cells into `page`: backgrounds, then aligned text, then cell  borders and (if given) the outer border around `blockRect`.

name: paintRowSlice
doc: Paint the rows named by `rowIndices` with the first row's top at `sliceTop`,  wrapped in one outer-border block.

name: drawTable
doc: Lay out `table` with its top-left corner at (x, top) in PDF user space and  draw its backgrounds, cell text (aligned), and borders into the page's  /Contents.

name: SpanShape
doc: A cell's declared span, the only thing the grid needs from it.

name: Placement
doc: Where one cell actually sits, after both clamps.

properties.name: row
properties.doc: Absolute row index of the cell's top-left corner.

properties.name: col
properties.doc: Absolute column index of that corner.

properties.name: rowSpan
properties.doc: Span after both clamps — what measure, paint and /RowSpan all read.

properties.name: columnCount
properties.doc: `max(col + colSpan)` over every placement; 0 for an empty table.

name: buildSpanGrid
doc: Place every cell of `rows` (each row's cells in order) onto an occupancy  grid, clamping each `rowSpan` to the table end and to the repeating-header  block.

name: applySpanDeficits
doc: Settle every spanning cell's height shortfall against `rowHeights`, in  place.

name: columnBoundaries
doc: Sorted, tolerance-deduplicated vertical cell boundaries of a table.

name: signatureMatch
doc: Two consecutive-page tables continue each other when they have the same  column count and pairwise-aligned column boundaries.

name: headerKey
doc: Per-column trimmed text of a row, ordered by column.

name: repeatsHeader
doc: True if follower's row 0 duplicates the leader's header row (all columns).

name: emitChain
doc: Concatenate a chain's rows into one Table: rows renumbered contiguously,  cell quads left page-local, quad/summary from the leader, pageSpans per page.

name: SpanRefs
doc: The reference cuts and the modal count behind them.

name: groupLines
doc: Group fragments into text lines by baseline; returns lines top→bottom.

name: columnCuts
doc: Column boundaries from vertical whitespace gaps present across all rows.

name: modalCount
doc: The most common fragment-count among `lines`, ties resolving to the HIGHER  count.

name: referenceCuts
doc: Column cuts derived from the modal rows ALONE — the boundaries a spanning row  has not distorted — or undefined when there is not enough majority structure  to trust.

name: spanSeparators
doc: A `vSep` matrix with `false` wherever a single-fragment, non-reference row's  text clears a reference cut — or undefined when no span was found, so the  caller keeps the grid it already built byte for byte.

name: median
doc: Median of a numeric list (0 for empty).

name: largestGap
doc: Largest gap in 1-D coverage of the given intervals (undefined if none).
return_type: { lo: number; hi: number; size: number } | undefined

name: candidateSplits
doc: Candidate splits on each axis whose largest full-span whitespace band exceeds  its threshold, ordered by how much it exceeds it (most-exceeding first).

name: segmentBlocks
doc: Recursively XY-cut fragments into spatially-separated blocks, detecting one  whitespace table per leaf.

name: findTables
doc: Collect only top-level Table elements — a table found inside another table's  cells is attached to that cell by buildTable, not returned at top level.

name: collectNested
doc: The nearest-enclosed Table elements inside `elem`: descend through non-Table  descendants, stop at and collect the first Table on each branch.

name: tableRows
doc: Flatten a Table's children into ordered rows with their section label.

name: cellQuad
doc: The page-space quad for a cell: /BBox layout attribute, else glyph union.

name: primaryPage
doc: Primary page of a Table: page of its first content-bearing cell, else /Pg.

name: tableFromStruct
doc: The Table model for a single tagged `Table` structure element, built on the  page its content lives on.

name: extractTaggedTables
doc: Extract tables from a page's tagged /Table structure elements.

properties.name: structParent
properties.doc: Element to append the /Table under; a /Table element is *reused* rather  than nested.

name: TableTagger
doc: Builds the /Table subtree for one `AddTable` call.

methods.name: beginRow
methods.doc: Open a /TR.

methods.name: cell
methods.doc: Append this cell's /TD or /TH to the open /TR and return it.

methods.name: figure
methods.doc: Append a /Figure to `cellElem` for its image, carrying `alt` when given.

properties.name: table
properties.doc: The root /Table element this tagger fills.

name: validateTableTagging
doc: Validate a table's tagging options.

name: headerScope
doc: The /Scope a cell's /TH carries, or undefined when the cell is a /TD.

name: PlaceOptions
doc: Options for {@link Template.PlaceOn}.

properties.name: fit
properties.doc: `'stretch'` (default) fills `rect` exactly; `'contain'` scales uniformly  and centres, preserving the template's aspect ratio.

properties.name: opacity
properties.doc: Constant opacity 0..1 via an /ExtGState, as `AddImage` takes.

properties.name: rotation
properties.doc: Rotation in DEGREES counter-clockwise about the rect's ORIGIN — the point  `(rect[0], rect[1])` — matching what `stamp.ts` documents for `AddText`.

name: Template
doc: A reusable piece of drawn content, placed on any number of pages from a  single Form XObject.

methods.name: constructor
methods.doc: @internal Use {@link Document.NewTemplate}.

methods.name: PlaceOn
methods.doc: Draw this template onto `page` inside `rect` (`[x, y, w, h]`).

name: rotateAbout
doc: A rotation of `degrees` counter-clockwise about the point (`x`, `y`).

name: Matrix
doc: 2x3 affine matrix [a b c d e f] with row-vector convention:  x' = a*x + c*y + e ; y' = b*x + d*y + f.

name: Run
doc: A positioned text run in device space.

properties.name: vertical
properties.doc: Vertical writing (`/WMode 1`): the run reads downward and `endY` is where  it ends.

name: RefRun
doc: A run carrying an optional provenance ref attached to each of its chars.

name: GlyphEvent
doc: A positioned glyph with provenance back to the operator that drew it.

properties.name: font
properties.doc: The font active when this glyph was shown (for re-encoding on replace).

properties.name: quad
properties.doc: Device-space axis box [x0,y0,x1,y1]: x from the pen span, y from baseline..baseline+size.

properties.name: fontSize
properties.doc: Effective font size in device units (quad height: fontSize * CTM vscale).

properties.name: angle
properties.doc: Baseline angle in radians: atan2 of the text→device matrix x-basis.

properties.name: elementIndex
properties.doc: Index within a TJ array element list; 0 for Tj/'/".

properties.name: byteStart
properties.doc: This glyph's code offset/length within its show string.

properties.name: advance
properties.doc: Glyph-space advance *along the writing direction* (em units), font size  and char/word spacing folded in, CTM/hscale divided out.

properties.name: vertical
properties.doc: True when the font's CMap is `/WMode 1`: the glyph advances down the page,  and `quad` is the cell it occupies rather than a baseline-anchored box.

properties.name: mcid
properties.doc: The innermost active marked-content MCID when this glyph was drawn,  or undefined outside any MCID-bearing marked-content sequence.

properties.name: artifact
properties.doc: True when this glyph was drawn inside an /Artifact marked-content scope.

properties.name: color
properties.doc: The fill colour in force when this glyph was shown, RGB 0..255.

name: ImageEvent
doc: A placed image with provenance.

properties.name: quad
properties.doc: Device-space box of the unit square mapped through the CTM.

properties.name: ctm
properties.doc: The CTM active at the image draw (maps the image unit square to device).

properties.name: stream
properties.doc: The image XObject that was drawn.

properties.name: mcid
properties.doc: The innermost active marked-content MCID, or undefined when untagged.

properties.name: artifact
properties.doc: True when drawn inside an /Artifact marked-content scope.

name: PathEvent
doc: A painted vector path, its subpaths flattened to page-space segments.

properties.name: mcid
properties.doc: The innermost active marked-content MCID when this path was painted,  or undefined outside any MCID-bearing marked-content sequence.

properties.name: artifact
properties.doc: True when this path was painted inside an /Artifact marked-content scope.

name: GState
doc: The subset of the graphics state this walker threads: the CTM, the fill  colour, and the converter that resolves that colour's operands.

name: PdfStreamLike
doc: Structural shape inflateStream expects (a PdfStream).

name: Rect
doc: A page-space rectangle [x0,y0,x1,y1] (corners in any order).

name: RegionHits
doc: Glyph and image events intersecting a set of regions.

name: TextFragment
doc: A positioned text run sharing one font, size, and baseline — the public unit  of structured extraction (`Page.GetTextFragments`).

properties.name: text
properties.doc: The fragment's decoded text (includes any literal space glyphs).

properties.name: quad
properties.doc: Page-space axis box [x0,y0,x1,y1]: x from the pen span, y baseline..baseline+size.

properties.name: fontSize
properties.doc: Effective font size in page units.

properties.name: fontName
properties.doc: The producing font's /BaseFont name, or undefined if the font has none.

properties.name: bold
properties.doc: True when the producing font declares itself bold / italic (see  `fontStyleOf`, the single owner of that question).

properties.name: angle
properties.doc: Baseline angle in radians; absent when horizontal.

properties.name: vertical
properties.doc: True when the run is set vertically (`/WMode 1`): it reads top-to-bottom  within `quad`, and its column orders right-to-left against its siblings.

properties.name: script
properties.doc: Set when this run reads as a sub- or superscript of its own line.

name: StyleSpan
doc: A half-open range of a line's `text` sharing one emphasis.

properties.name: script
properties.doc: Sub/superscript over this range, absent for ordinary text.

properties.name: quad
properties.doc: Page-space bounding box [x0,y0,x1,y1] of the line's fragments.

properties.name: styles
properties.doc: Where the emphasis changes along `text`, or absent when nothing on the  line is bold or italic — which is every line in the existing snapshots.

name: TextBlock
doc: A paragraph-like cluster of consecutive lines, ordered top-to-bottom.

properties.name: quad
properties.doc: Page-space bounding box [x0,y0,x1,y1] of the block's lines.

name: mul
doc: m followed by n: point p -> (p·m)·n.

name: invert
doc: Inverse of a 2×3 affine matrix.

name: vscale
doc: Vertical scale magnitude of a matrix (effective font-size multiplier).

name: transformedExtent
doc: The aligned bounding box of `bbox` transformed by `m` (a form's /Matrix),  returned as `[w, h]`; `undefined` for a degenerate (zero-area) box.

name: containMatrix
doc: Place a form's `bbox` (under its /Matrix `m`) inside `rect`  (`[x0, y0, x1, y1]`) scaled UNIFORMLY and centred, preserving aspect ratio;  `undefined` for a degenerate box.

name: runFromGlyph
doc: Build the layout run for one glyph event.

name: layoutLines
doc: Lay runs out into lines (by Y) and order/space them (by X), returning the  assembled text plus, for every character, the ref of the run that produced  it (`undefined` for inserted spaces and line breaks).

name: axisKeys
doc: Where a run sits, in coordinates that make one algorithm serve both writing directions: `line` selects the line or column and sorts earliest-first, and `start`/`end` run along the writing direction, also increasing.
return_type: { line: number; start: number; end: number }

name: layoutOneDirection
doc: Lay out runs that all read the same way.

name: assembleLines
doc: Group runs into lines (by Y) and order/space them (by X) into a string.

name: visitContent
doc: Walk a page's content (all /Contents streams, then into Form XObjects),  emitting glyph/image events with provenance.

name: visitFormContent
doc: Walk one Form XObject's content as though `cm base` + `Do` had drawn it: the  stream's own /Matrix is applied on top of `base`, and its /Resources fall  back to `fallbackResources`.

name: lookupFillCs
doc: Resolve a `cs` operand to its converter, looking a non-device name up in  /Resources /ColorSpace.

name: walkScope
doc: Walk one graphics-state scope (the page's content array, or a single  XObject), threading text/CTM state across the given streams.

name: contentStreamBytes
doc: The inflated bytes of each /Contents stream, in order.

name: emitGlyphArray
doc: Handle a TJ array: strings emit glyphs, numbers shift the text matrix.

name: emitImage
doc: Emit an image-placement event for the unit square under the current CTM.

name: mapRegions
doc: Collect the glyph/image events whose device-space box intersects any `rects`.

name: fragmentsFromGlyphs
doc: Group consecutive glyph events sharing font, size, baseline angle, and  baseline (with no large horizontal gap) into positioned fragments.

name: buildFragments
doc: `fragmentsFromGlyphs`, optionally recording which input glyphs each fragment  consumed: `spans[i]` is the [from, to) range of `glyphs` behind `out[i]`.

name: markScriptLevel
doc: Label each fragment that reads as a sub- or superscript of its own line.

name: scriptsInLine
doc: Label the scripts within one line of two or more fragments.

name: scriptByGlyph
doc: Label each glyph with the sub/superscript its own LINE makes it, through the  same fragment assembly and `markScriptLevel` every other consumer uses.

name: extractFragments
doc: Walk a page's content and group consecutive glyphs into positioned fragments,  in content order.

name: extractStructured
